jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a structured, proactive, and analytical partner-management professional who combines operational discipline with strong relationship-building skills. You challenge incomplete information, communicate clearly across cultures and time zones, and follow issues through to documented closure.

You are equally comfortable managing detailed onboarding and systems-of-record administration and leading direct conversations about partner readiness, performance, compliance, and corrective action. You balance productive long-term partnerships with sound judgment, process integrity, customer impact, and business accountability.

About The Role

As the Subcontractor-Partner Manager, you will own the operational execution of Myriad360's subcontractor-partner lifecycle, from sourcing, qualification, onboarding, competitive bidding, and systems administration through engagement monitoring, performance management, corrective action, requalification, and continuous improvement. You will report to the VP of Subcontractor-Partner Program Management and work closely with Strategic Priorities Operations and cross-functional stakeholders in the United States.

Other responsibilities include:

Subcontractor-Partner Operations Onboarding Analyst

  • Operations Process and Systems Execution: Perform defined Service Strategic Priorities Operations workflows within the processes, controls, data standards, and systems managed by Sarah Gold and her team; coordinate access, issue resolution, workflow changes, and data-quality improvements with Strategic Priorities Operations.
  • Partner Master Data and Onboarding: Maintain the consolidated subcontractor-partner database; create and update partner records; connect partners to customers, projects, services, geographies, spend, capabilities, certifications, contracts, SOWs, compliance status, evaluations, and performance history.
  • Qualification, Compliance, and Requalification: Research prospective partners; collect and validate onboarding, insurance, security, certification, contract, compliance information; administer annual requalification; and post approved status changes to the systems of record.
  • Quote, Bid, and Selection Administration: Manage standardized quote solicitations, track responses, normalize pricing, evaluate compliance and value, prepare scoring matrices and recommendations, and document shared selection decisions and supporting evidence.
  • Contract, SOW, and Engagement Setup: Coordinate Solution Provider Agreement (SPA’s), similar to Master Service Agreements (MSA’s), but for Subcontractors, contracts, Solution Proposal’s (SP’s) similar to Statements of Work (SOW’s), reviews, approvals, and engagement setup; confirm active work is linked to an approved partner and authorized SP/SOW; identify and escalate missing or unauthorized documentation.
  • Evaluations, Scorecards, and Engagement Health: Administer engagement closeouts and evaluations; maintain scorecards, capability records, RAG health, performance trends, project-status information, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Exception and Corrective-Action Tracking: Maintain cost, effort, schedule, quality, customer, rework, replacement-cost, customer-credit, margin-erosion, double-effort, and recovery logs; track owners, due dates, evidence, escalation, and closure status.
  • Reporting, Sourcing, and Improvement: Prepare dashboards, QBR materials, management reports, meeting records, and action logs; perform capability, capacity, certification, and geographic gap analysis; document procedures; track milestones; and escalate operational or security risks.

Subcontractor-Partner Manager

  • Program Operations: Manage the daily operating cadence for partner readiness, engagement follow-up, performance reviews, requalification, corrective actions, escalation, and reporting.
  • Partner Relationship Management: Serve as a primary operational contact for approved partners, reinforce customer, communication, quality, documentation, and accountability standards, and build productive long-term relationships.
  • Shared Partner Selection: Review partner qualifications, delivery capability, availability, geography, pricing, compliance, past performance, customer fit, and risk; participate with Bill Bickham and applicable stakeholders in criteria-based selection decisions. The role does not select partners unilaterally.
  • Engagement Risk and Performance Management: Review subcontractor-supported engagements for scope, schedule, quality, documentation, communication, customer impact, cost, margin, and non-green conditions; use evaluations and scorecards to drive timely response and recommend partner-status changes.
  • Corrective Action and Recovery: Lead partner corrective-action discussions, confirm owners and closure criteria, hold parties accountable for completion, and support recovery or commercial action for rework, replacement costs, credits, margin leakage, and delivery failures.
  • Compliance, Requalification, and Partner Status: Review compliance and annual requalification information, resolve or escalate gaps, and recommend preferred, approved, conditional, inactive, restricted, suspended, held, or reinstated status based on documented evidence.
  • Cross-Functional Governance: Coordinate with Strategic Priorities Operations, PMO, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Security, Presales, Solution Architecture, Sales, and partner teams; lead QBRs, assess capacity and pipeline readiness, and recommend improvements to standards, workflows, tools, and the partner ecosystem.
  • Partner Development and Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring delivery or communication issues, apply root-cause analysis, recognize high-performing partners, and recommend actions that strengthen partner quality, coverage, scalability, and long-term value.
  • Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section
  • Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts
  • Other duties as assigned

Desired skills and experience:

  • Five or more years of experience in subcontractor, vendor, or partner management; IT services operations; professional-services administration; procurement operations; project operations; or related business operations.
  • Experience in an IT services, managed services, consulting, systems-integration, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or technology-services environment.
  • Working knowledge of SOWs, fixed-price and time-and-materials delivery, project financials, cost controls, resource capacity, delivery quality, and customer-impact considerations.
  • Experience with partner onboarding, assessments, quote and bid processes, contract or SPA support, compliance administration, scorecards, QBRs, corrective actions, and requalification.
  • Ability to interpret project status, cost, effort, schedule, quality, customer, compliance, and operational-risk data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills, with experience using CRM, PSA/project-management, ERP, contract-management, collaboration, and reporting systems.
  • Strong organization, analysis, written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, sound judgment, and follow-through; ability to support United States-based stakeholders from Manila and participate in recurring meetings across time zones.
  • Managing or governing IT subcontractors, delivery partners, technical consultants, professional-services providers, or outsourced delivery resources.
  • Salesforce, NetSuite, OpenAir/SuiteProjects Pro, ScopeStack, Smartsheet, Power BI, Microsoft 365, Slack, ChatGPT, or comparable platforms.
  • Partner tiering, preferred-partner programs, supplier segmentation, strategic sourcing, capability and geographic coverage planning, process mapping or automation, and offshore or KMC-supported operating environments.

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

  • We Before Me: We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other’s shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.
  • Dare To Be Great: We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.
  • Own It: We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.

We are consistently listed among Inc & Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible & engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.

This role defines target-state architecture and implementation patterns for customer identity and access management and enterprise identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, federation, lifecycle orchestration, delegated administration, and identity data flows across cloud and enterprise platforms.

The architect partners with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application owners, product teams, and business stakeholders to translate business, security, privacy, and user experience requirements into practical identity architectures. This role also provides technical leadership for integrations across platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Azure, AWS, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and custom applications, with an emphasis on security, reliability, maintainability, and business enablement.

Duties/Responsibilities

      • Lead the architecture and design of CIAM and IAM solutions that support secure customer, partner, and workforce identity use cases across digital and enterprise environments.

      • Define reference architectures, technical standards, integration patterns, and guardrails for identity services, authentication flows, authorization models, and lifecycle automation.

      • Architect solutions for federation, single sign-on, adaptive authentication, MFA, delegated administration, identity proofing, registration, account recovery, consent, and progressive profiling.

      • Author an improvement plan to transform the way Agent and Agentic NHI risks are handled, enabling the business to continue rapid Agent creation in a secure manner.

      • Design identity application patterns and integrations using standards and protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, LDAP, REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.

      • Lead solution design for customer onboarding, workforce onboarding, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access request workflows, and fine-grained entitlement or role models where applicable.

      • Evaluate and improve existing identity platforms, custom integrations, and application access patterns to reduce risk, technical debt, and operational friction.

      • Ensure identity solutions are designed for resilience, scalability, observability, auditability, privacy, and compliance by design.

      • Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, standards, roadmaps, decision records, and implementation guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

      • Facilitate design reviews, threat-informed architecture reviews, and technical governance activities for identity-related initiatives.

      • Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to assess new capabilities, validate patterns, and recommend improvements aligned to strategic identity goals.

Job Description

  • The Principal Data / Solution Architect is the senior hands-on architect responsible for designing the reusable data and solution architectures that power the enterprise’s data and digital products through MVP. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Solution Architecture, this role translates architectural direction into concrete, buildable designs on the centralized, enterprise-agnostic medallion architecture models.
  • This is a deep-expertise individual contributor role — the technical authority on data modeling, solution design, and the medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold). The Principal Architect works shoulder-to-shoulder with Data Engineering, Data Analysis & Products, Digital Product, and Analytics teams to design reusable assets, refactor bespoke work onto governed sources, and apply AI and automation to compress modeling time.
  • This role is a critical execution counterpart to the engineering teams, ensuring that architectural intent is realized in production-ready, reusable designs rather than one-off builds. The Principal Architect sets the technical standard others build against and mentors engineers and analysts on architecture and modeling best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Data & Solution Architecture

  • Design the reusable, scalable, enterprise-agnostic data models and solution architectures that underpin the enterprise medallion architecture.
  • Produce concrete architecture artifacts — data models, solution blueprints, reference patterns, and design specifications — that engineering and product teams build against.
  • Translate the Senior Director’s architectural direction into buildable, production-ready designs aligned to enterprise standards.

Modeling & Silver-Layer Design

  • Own the design of the medallion architecture, ensuring data is structured for reuse across multiple use cases rather than bespoke consumption.
  • Define transformation logic, data relationships, semantics, and readiness criteria needed by Data Engineering and Analysis teams.
  • Refactor raw, bespoke solutions onto the centralized, agnostic Silver model so value is captured once and reused many times.

AI-Accelerated Design & Automation

  • Apply AI and automation to accelerate modeling, design, and documentation — compressing the modeling cycle that has historically slowed the path to production.
  • Build and reuse accelerators, templates, and design patterns that turn learning-stage work into durable, production-ready assets.
  • Embed human-in-the-loop checkpoints so acceleration never bypasses governance, security, or quality expectations.

Hands-On Delivery & Integration

  • Partner directly with Data Engineering to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and promoted to production through governed CI/CD pipelines.
  • Integrate data and digital product solutions onto shared, reusable sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise medallion model.
  • Validate that engineered datasets, data products, and integrated solutions reflect the architectural design and support reuse.

Technical Standards & Mentorship

  • Serve as the technical authority on data and solution architecture, setting patterns and standards others build against.
  • Mentor and guide engineers and analysts on modeling, architecture, and reusable design best practices.
  • Contribute to the centralized library of reusable models, patterns, and components so every asset compounds the value of the next.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • Deep, hands-on experience as a data architect and/or solution architect in a complex enterprise data environment.
  • Expert knowledge of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), reusable data modeling, and enterprise-agnostic data design.
  • Proven ability to translate architectural direction into concrete, buildable data models and solution designs.
  • Strong hands-on experience refactoring bespoke solutions into reusable, production-ready assets.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated code evaluation, and controlled promotion to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI and automation to accelerate modeling and design while preserving quality and governance.
  • Strong technical communication and mentorship skills; experience in complex, regulated enterprises preferred.

Measures of Success

  • Architecture and design artifacts are reusable, scalable, and consistently adopted across use cases.
  • Bespoke and raw solutions are consistently refactored onto reusable, agnostic Silver sources.
  • Modeling and design cycle time is measurably reduced through AI and automation.
  • Designs are implemented faithfully and reach production through governed, automated pipelines.
  • Engineers and analysts adopt the architectural patterns and standards the role establishes.
  • Acceleration is achieved without compromising governance, quality, or security controls.

jobs.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview :

We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Telugu- speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.

You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.

  • Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.
  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.

Requirements

  • Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.
  • Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.
  • Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

jobs.title: Vice President Data Center Design
jobs.excerpt: At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a Vice President Data Center Design leads the delivery of Montera’s facility designs across the portfolio. Reporting to the CTO, the VP owns design execution end to end — from reference architecture through IFC and construction support — and is the senior leader of Montera’s Principal Engineering & Architecture Leadership family and its external design and construction partners.

This is a people-leadership and delivery-accountability role, distinct from the CTO’s external technical and customer-facing mandate. The CTO owns customer requirements capture and is the technical external face of Montera; the VP converts those requirements into buildable, coordinated, on-schedule designs and drives them through the design and construction partner ecosystem (CSA, MEP, design-assist trades, GC/CM, and specialty consultants) to a predictable, commissioned outcome.

The VP manages the five Principal ICs — Architect & Master Planning, Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, and Network — aligning their reference architectures into a single coherent facility design, resolving cross-discipline conflicts, and holding the integrated design schedule and budget. The role is accountable for design quality, constructability, multi-discipline coordination, and the design inputs to cost, schedule, and availability targets across active projects (currently Eagle and Goldeneye) and the broader pipeline.

Requirements

What You'll Do

Design Delivery & Program Execution

  • Own end-to-end design delivery across the portfolio — concept, SD, DD, IFP/IFC, and construction-phase support — against committed schedule milestones (e.g., schematic design and IFC dates) and yield-on-cost targets.
  • Hold the integrated, multi-discipline design schedule and budget; drive the critical path across architectural, electrical, mechanical, controls, and network scopes.
  • Govern design change control, trade studies, and value-engineering decisions, protecting design intent, reliability targets (five-nines availability), and operability.
  • Own the design basis of design (BOD) and its consistent application across projects, and the design deliverables that feed permitting, procurement, and construction.

Leadership of the Principal Engineering & Architecture Family

  • Directly lead and develop the five Principal ICs (Architect/Master Planning, Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Network); set objectives, review performance, and build the discipline centers of excellence.
  • Integrate discipline reference architectures into one coherent, coordinated facility design; arbitrate cross-discipline trade-offs (e.g., power vs. cooling vs. space, controls data model vs. network segmentation).
  • Ensure the Controls–Network interlock on customer data exposure is delivered jointly and coherently, consistent with the single-tenant model and the requirements the CTO captures.
  • Enforce portfolio-wide design standards, playbooks, and prototypical modules that enable rapid, repeatable deployment.

Design Contracts & Partner Governance

  • Define, review, negotiate, and manage design contracts with design partners (CSA and MEP engineers of record, design-assist trades, and specialty consultants) — owning scopes of work, deliverable schedules, standard of care, fee structures, and design responsibility matrices.
  • Establish consistent contracting standards and templates for design engagements across the portfolio; align scope boundaries and interface agreements so multi-discipline coverage is complete with no gaps or overlaps.
  • Manage contract performance through delivery: track deliverables against milestones, administer change and additional-services requests, review and approve design invoicing against progress, and resolve scope and performance issues.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and Procurement on design-contract terms, risk allocation, and commercial approvals, engaging qualified counsel on high-stakes terms.

Design & Construction Partner Leadership

  • Serve as Montera’s senior owner-side leader to external design and construction partners: CSA and MEP engineers of record, design-assist trade partners (e.g., mechanical and electrical), GC/CM, and specialty consultants.
  • Own the design-assist and delivery-model strategy (e.g., design-bid-build vs. design-assist) and the associated partner scopes, deliverables, and interface agreements.
  • Lead design reviews, coordination summits, and constructability reviews; drive partner accountability to quality, schedule, and cost.
  • Support AHJ permitting and entitlement outcomes through the Architect/Master Planning Principal and partner teams.

Design Oversight Through Construction

  • Own owner-side design oversight through construction with GCs and subcontractors — protecting design intent from IFC through commissioning and turnover.
  • Govern the construction-phase design workflow: RFIs, submittals and shop-drawing review, and coordination/BIM clash resolution across trades, driving timely engineer-of-record responses.
  • Review and disposition field changes, design-related change orders, and value-engineering proposals from GCs and subs; safeguard reliability (five-nines availability), operability, and standards conformance.
  • Lead design representation at OAC meetings and site design reviews; track design-related construction risk and drive resolution with the GC, subs, and design partners.
  • Ensure as-built and design close-out documentation from GCs and subs is complete and fed back into Montera reference designs and standards.

Constructability, Commissioning & Handover

  • Ensure designs are constructable, coordinated (clash-free), and aligned to procurement lead times and site logistics.
  • Own the design-side inputs to commissioning and integrated systems testing (IST); ensure acceptance criteria and turnover readiness are designed in, not retrofitted.
  • Drive lessons-learned from construction and operations back into reference designs and standards for continuous fleet improvement.

Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment

  • Translate the CTO-captured customer requirements into a governed design program and report design status, risks, and decisions to the CTO and leadership.
  • Partner with Development, Delivery, Operations, GRC, and Finance on schedule, cost, constructability, and interconnection-driven design constraints (e.g., FRT / utility obligations).
  • Provide design content and technical substantiation to support the CTO’s customer engagements and executive/board materials, without owning the customer-facing relationship.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related); professional licensure (PE/RA) preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in data center or mission-critical design and delivery, including senior leadership of multi-discipline design programs for hyperscale or AI-focused facilities.
  • Proven track record leading design across full delivery lifecycle (concept to IFC to commissioning) with accountability for schedule, cost, and quality.
  • Demonstrated leadership of principal/expert individual contributors and of external design and construction partners (CSA, MEP, design-assist, GC/CM).
  • Proven experience defining, negotiating, and managing design contracts (scope, deliverables, standard of care, fees, change control) and administering owner-side design oversight through construction with GCs and subcontractors (RFIs, submittals, change orders, field changes).
  • Strong command of how architectural, electrical, mechanical, controls, and network scopes integrate, and of delivery models (design-bid-build, design-assist, EPC).
  • Excellent judgment on constructability, value engineering, and design risk; strong commercial and schedule discipline.
  • Exceptional communication; able to represent design internally to the CTO, leadership, and board, and to lead partners externally.

Why Join Montera?

You will work closely with client executives, operational leaders, and technology teams to understand complex challenges and translate them into responsible, achievable AI solutions. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience applying AI and agentic solutions in payer or managed-care environments and can operate as both a trusted advisor and a delivery leader. Client engagement and advisory

Solution development and delivery

  • Lead the design and delivery of AI and automation solutions for payer workflows, including utilization management, claims processing, care management, member services, and administrative operations.

Strategy and capability development

  • Help evolve the client’s AI solution portfolio by identifying new offerings, capabilities, partnerships, and opportunities for differentiation.
  • Collaborate with technology, delivery, compliance, and commercial teams to ensure AI initiatives align with business strategy and client expectations.
  • Develop practical responsible-AI frameworks addressing privacy, security, HIPAA compliance, reliability, governance, and organizational change.
  • Define and monitor success measures for AI initiatives and clearly communicate results to client and internal stakeholders.
  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies, payer-industry trends, and relevant regulatory developments.

Qualifications

Dura Digital is a global digital transformation and consulting company that helps organizations turn emerging technologies into practical business outcomes. Associate Director of People & Operations - Mission Statement:

The Associate Director of People & Operations designs the systems, policies, and team resources that enable Watson Institute to become the highest performing team our employees have ever been part of in the social impact sector. This role transforms complex growth periods into clear policies, scalable processes, and beautifully designed resources that strengthen our culture and empower our team to do their best work.

Associate Director of People & Operations – Role:

Designing People Systems & Strategy - 50%:
Lead the research, design, and implementation of systems, policies, and resources that enable Watson Institute to become the highest performing team our employees have ever been part of in the social impact sector:

  • As Watson Institute continues to grow, proactively research emerging best practices and evaluate leading approaches to develop thoughtful, scalable systems, policies, and resources that strengthen our team.
  • Think strategically about Watson Institute’s future growth by anticipating the people and operational priorities that growth will create and building scalable systems to support it. Approach growth as something to prepare for and enable, with a solutions-oriented mindset, ensuring our policies, processes, and resources can sustain the organization as it evolves.
  • Lead high impact organizational initiatives including professional development planning, management training, workplace culture decks, and other strategic priorities as Watson Institute continues to grow.
  • As Watson Institute continues to expand its contractor workforce, help define what an exceptional contractor experience looks like at Watson Institute by creating a gold standard approach to how we engage, support, and collaborate with contractors while appropriately recognizing the unique nature of their engagement.
  • Partner with leaders across Watson Institute to identify operational challenges, research innovative solutions, and translate these solutions into practical systems that enable our team to do their best work.
  • Approach every project with the mindset that excellence is found in the details, producing work that is thoughtful, polished, and ready for organization-wide implementation.
  • Design clear, polished, and visually compelling systems, guides, playbooks, and other resources using Canva (or similar graphic design platforms).
  • Translate strategy into execution by developing clear project plans, establishing timelines and milestones, coordinating cross functional implementation, and embracing a GyShiDo Master mindset (which is the art of productivity and getting your stuff done) to ensure every initiative moves from idea to reality.

Team Culture & Engagement - 20%:

Design meaningful experiences that strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture across Watson Institute's globally distributed team:

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Watson Institute's All Team Meetings, creating engaging experiences that foster collaboration, strengthen relationships, and reinforce our culture.
  • Partner with the CEO & Founder and COO & Co-Founder to design and facilitate Town Hall Meetings that engage our team in organizational strategy, celebrate milestones, and create opportunities for meaningful dialogue and shared ownership of Watson Institute's future.
  • Design and coordinate team engagement initiatives that strengthen community, celebrate our principles, and create opportunities for employees to volunteer and make an impact within their local communities and the communities we serve.

Special Projects - 30%:

Partner closely with members of the People & Operations Team to support high priority initiatives that are critical to Watson Institute’s growth. Whether it is sourcing candidates, evaluating applications, conducting exploratory calls, leading interviews, or stepping into other special projects, embrace Watson Institute's full court press mentality by showing hustle, grit, and a willingness to go the extra mile to help the team succeed.

*New responsibilities may develop as the position evolves.

Requirements

Culture Add:

In order to thrive as the Associate Director of People & Operations at Watson Institute, a candidate must:

  • Eager to join a team with extremely high standards for quality and excellence, recognizing that demonstrating excellence in partnership building is a direct path to scaling impact and achieving outsized results.
  • An exceptional eye for visual design. You enjoy spending time in the details with words, style, formatting, and talking points in order to make the most compelling product possible.
  • Detail Oriented: You are meticulous and have excellent organizational skills. You are especially attuned to spotting mistakes or inconsistencies in writing and external communications. You take pride in completing your work accurately and on schedule. You have a knack for project management and a love for work plans and checklists. You cringe at missed steps and you are the first to identify a typo or formatting error.
  • Intentional: Your working style is about creating order and planning ahead. You think systematically and excel at establishing elegant processes.
  • Results-Driven: You bring an eagerness to grow and to roll up your sleeves and contribute. You have a go-getter attitude and a drive to solve all sorts of problems, no matter the size or shape. When you take on a responsibility, you find a way to see it through to the end.
  • High Integrity: You will be asked to make sensitive and critical judgment calls, and as such, you are known for your integrity and you take that reputation seriously. You always choose to make the right decision versus the easy decision. You know what information is sensitive, and you will protect it accordingly. You are comfortable escalating issues and holding your ground when you think it’s the right thing to do for the organization and mission.
  • Systems-minded: Demonstrated experience in building and implementing systems. You are comfortable designing, testing, improving, and smoothly running systems and processes. This could be any system that involves inputs from or serves multiple people and requires consistent and accurate functioning.
  • Communication Style: Based on a story from Watson Institute’s early days, ‘Come to the Window’ represents the principles of our communication including:
    • Obligation to Dissent: If you disagree with a decision or direction as an organization, you are expected to bring attention to this challenge because true leaders believe dissent is an obligation.
    • Disagree and Commit: To complement Obligation to Dissent, there are times when we need to Disagree and Commit. Once all concerns and criticisms are shared, the course of action must be committed to by all involved.
    • No Drama: We prioritize purpose and don’t involve ourselves in the drama created by backroom chatter, hearsay, and unnecessary focus on issues that do not place impact first.
    • Go to the Source: Our culture is defined by direct, honest, and frequent communication. We expect team members to ‘go to the source’ of concerns by speaking up, communicating frequently, and taking issues directly to the individuals involved.

Candidate Profile:

Top candidates should demonstrate:

  • A deep-seated passion for Watson Institute’s mission to develop innovators, leaders, and entrepreneurs to solve the toughest challenges facing the world.
  • Be undaunted by switching between projects and disciplines on any given day.
  • Believe that when work is done with excellence, the magic is in the details.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • A systems-oriented and highly organized approach to work.
  • A natural curiosity and resourcefulness to research unfamiliar challenges, evaluate best practices, and identify the highest quality systems and solutions to strengthen our team.
  • A passion for designing and leading engaging internal presentations and team sessions that strengthen our culture, foster connection, and inspire excellence.
  • A love and talent for designing polished, visually compelling decks, policy documents, and resources using Canva (or similar graphic design platforms).
  • Mandatory skills: Research mastery, email wizardry, rapid follow-up, and Canva (or similar graphic design platforms).

Benefits

Benefits:

  • Unlimited vacations (3 weeks required vacation time per year).

responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

jobs.description:
About Us

Hawthorne Health is a leading community site network and home research visit solution provider, with 20+ sites and more than 2,000 research experienced healthcare professionals across the U.S. Hawthorne leverages convenient, trusted, healthcare locations, identified patient data, and intelligent technology to accelerate patient access, improve retention, and reduce study costs. By embedding high-quality research within local communities, Hawthorne makes clinical trials more accessible and convenient for patients. Our community-based model shortens timelines and helps bring better treatments to market, faster.

About the Role

Hawthorne Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to join our growing clinical research network on a PRN contract basis, supporting clinical trial participants through our Boynton Beach, Florida research site.

This is a remote, part-time opportunity for a Registered Dietitian interested in bringing their expertise into the clinical research space. The Dietitian may be based anywhere in the United States but must maintain an active Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) credential and active Florida Dietitian/Nutritionist license to provide services to participants located in Florida.

In this role, you will conduct virtual nutrition and lifestyle counseling sessions with clinical trial participants in accordance with study protocols. Visits will be scheduled based on study requirements, participant enrollment, and patient availability, so we’re looking for someone who can provide consistent part-time support as patient visits are scheduled.

You’ll partner closely with our clinical research team to provide an engaging, high-quality participant experience while ensuring study-specific requirements and documentation are completed accurately and on time.

This is a great opportunity for a Dietitian seeking part-time work and exposure to the growing field of clinical research, while directly supporting patients participating in innovative clinical trials.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct 30-minute, protocol-required telehealth nutrition and lifestyle counseling sessions with assigned clinical trial participants every four weeks throughout the 52-week study period.
  • Provide individualized, evidence-based nutrition counseling and lifestyle education in accordance with the clinical trial protocol and sponsor requirements.
  • Educate participants on healthy dietary habits, physical activity, and sustainable lifestyle modifications to support study objectives.
  • Utilize motivational interviewing and participant-centered communication techniques to encourage participant engagement and adherence throughout the study.
  • Accurately document all participant interactions, counseling sessions, and required assessments in study documentation and electronic systems.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Research Coordinators, Principal Investigators, and the study team to communicate participant progress, scheduling needs, and any protocol-related concerns.
  • Promptly report participant safety concerns, adverse events, or potential protocol deviations to the appropriate study personnel.
  • Complete all required study-specific training and maintain compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, HIPAA, sponsor requirements, and all applicable regulatory standards.
  • Maintain participant confidentiality while delivering a professional, compassionate, and engaging telehealth experience.
    Effectively manage a flexible remote schedule to ensure timely completion of assigned participant visits.

Requirements

  • Active Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) credential in good standing through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).
  • Current state licensure as a Registered/Licensed Dietitian, as required by the state(s) in which participants are located.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience providing nutrition counseling in a clinical, outpatient, telehealth, or wellness setting.
  • Experience counseling patients with obesity, weight management, metabolic health, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or related conditions preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of evidence-based nutrition therapy and behavior change strategies.
  • Excellent communication, motivational interviewing, and patient education skills.
  • Comfortable conducting participant visits via telehealth and documenting encounters electronically.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a multidisciplinary clinical research team.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a flexible schedule and complete documentation accurately and on time.
  • Reliable internet connection, laptop and private workspace suitable for telehealth visits.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous clinical research experience or familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP).
  • Experience supporting lifestyle intervention, obesity, metabolic, endocrinology, or cardiovascular programs.
  • Experience using electronic health records (EHR) and/or electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Current GCP certification (or willingness to complete upon hire).

Why Hawthorne Health?

At Hawthorne Health, we’re working to make clinical trials more accessible and convenient by bringing research closer to the patients and communities we serve.

As a Registered Dietitian supporting our research programs, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your clinical expertise in a new setting, work directly with clinical trial participants, and gain exposure to the growing clinical research industry—all while contributing to research that can help bring better therapies to patients faster.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleTorc’s Business Intelligence team partners across the company to bring visibility and reporting that help leadership and every function make faster, better-informed decisions.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Torc’s Business Intelligence team partners across the company to bring visibility and reporting that help leadership and every function make faster, better-informed decisions. We are looking for a senior technical leader who can own the data models and dashboards that power BI across the business — building the governed, reusable layer that sits between raw source systems and providing consistent reporting in all dashboards used by our stakeholders in different business units.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence. You’ll design and build the pipelines and data models that make reporting fast, trustworthy, and consistent, while also staying close enough to the business to know what leadership actually needs to see. You’ll be a hands-on technical lead for the BI function with a focus on engineering, safety, and operational data — setting standards for data modeling, validation, and reporting, while also mentoring analysts and engineers so the whole team levels up.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own the data models that serve as the single source of truth for BI reporting — structuring tables, views, and semantic layers so metrics are defined once and used consistently across all dashboards and tools.
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that feed those models, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and reliable at scale.
  • Partner with data producers and business stakeholders to translate reporting and decision-making needs into durable data models and pipelines, rather than one-off dashboard logic.
  • Define, instrument, and maintain business KPIs from scratch using SQL and Python, and ensure definitions stay consistent across teams and dashboards.
  • Build and enforce data quality checks, validation processes, and documentation so stakeholders can trust the numbers behind leadership- and board-level reporting.
  • Create and maintain actionable, user-friendly dashboards and visualizations (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to provide valuable insight.
  • Support and help evolve leadership-critical reporting deliverables, ensuring governed, well-documented data models rather than ad hoc queries.
  • Help evolve the team’s data platform and architecture (e.g., improving legacy pipelines), balancing pragmatism with long-term maintainability.
  • Work with IT and data partners to design secure, sustainable, and scalable paths for data access from source systems into BI-ready models.
  • Mentor team members across data engineering, data analysis, data validation, and BI reporting — through code and model reviews, pairing, documentation, and by setting reusable standards and best practices.
  • Cultivate data literacy across the organization through documentation, training, and clear communication of how and why data is modeled the way it is.
  • Answer complex business questions via ad hoc SQL or Python analysis when a question does not yet warrant a permanent model or dashboard.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude) to accelerate SQL, Python, and documentation work, applying sound engineering judgment to review, validate, and take ownership of any AI-generated output before it reaches production.
  • Evaluate and, where it adds value, implement AI/LLM-powered BI capabilities — such as natural-language querying, semantic layers, and AI-generated summaries or anomaly alerts — to keep our reporting stack modern and to help the team work more efficiently.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Analysis, or a related field with 6+ years of experience OR a Master's degree with 3+ years of experience.
  • Deep hands-on experience with data modeling and database/warehouse design — building governed, reusable data models that serve multiple downstream dashboards and reporting tools consistently.
  • Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python (pandas, PySpark, or similar) for pipeline development, transformation, and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining source-of-truth ETL/ELT pipelines, including data quality checks and validation processes, in production environments.
  • Experience with one or more BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, QuickSight, or similar), including enough hands-on dashboard-building experience to speak the language of BI analysts and evaluate their work.
  • A track record of mentoring or leading other engineers or analysts — through reviews, pairing, documentation, or setting team standards.
  • Comfort working with ambiguous, evolving requirements, and the ability to partner directly with stakeholders across the business to turn loosely defined problems into well-structured data models.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to document and explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in an agile environment and balancing multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted coding and productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude) to improve development speed, paired with the judgment to critically review and validate AI-assisted output.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar), particularly for serving data, visualizations, and jobs.
  • AWS experience, particularly Athena, Glue, or other managed data services.
  • Knowledge of relational, NoSQL, vector, and data warehouse/lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience with a transformation framework such as dbt, or building analogous version-controlled, tested data modeling practices.
  • Experience scaling data for ML/AI workloads.
  • Experience designing semantic/metrics layers or data models that support AI-powered or natural-language BI querying, and familiarity with applying LLMs to tasks like data quality checks, anomaly detection, or documentation generation.
  • Background in automotive, AV, robotics, or other safety-critical data environments.

Work Location

Ann Arbor, MI is the hiring hub for this role; remote candidates across the US will be considered.

Hiring Range for Job Opening

US Pay Range
$160,800—$193,000 USD

jobs.excerpt: The era of pervasive AI has arrived.  In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.
jobs.description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.

SambaNova Suite™ is the first full-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on-premises or in the cloud, combined with state-of-the-art open-source models that can be easily and securely fine-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.

Overview

The Senior Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the production-grade inference infrastructure that powers SambaNova's serving stack on our Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU) architecture. SambaNova is an inference-first company, and this role sits at the heart of that mission: turning state-of-the-art inference techniques into reliable, high-throughput, low-latency services exposed to customers through SambaStack and SambaCloud. The engineer will own end-to-end systems spanning request scheduling, advanced decoding algorithms, caching layers, API surfaces, and the accuracy infrastructure that keeps the stack trustworthy. This role partners closely with ML, compiler, runtime, and product teams to ship inference features from prototype to production.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of industry experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, ideally in ML serving
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design
  • Experience designing and maintaining production services with strict latency, throughput, and availability requirements
  • Working knowledge of modern LLM inference techniques and familiarity with open-source serving stacks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or SGLang
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Experience collaborating across teams to deliver complex, system-level engineering solutions

Key responsibilities

  • Design and productionize advanced inference techniques on RDU to optimize for performance and cost. Key areas include speculative decoding, constrained decoding, function/tool calling, prompt caching, and long-context inference.
  • Own SambaNova's integration with vLLM and adjacent serving frameworks, adapting them to RDU's architecture.
  • Own the public inference API surface exposed through SambaStack and SambaCloud.
  • Build and maintain the accuracy verification and regression infrastructure that gates every inference feature shipped to customers.
  • Partner with ML, compiler, runtime, and product teams to take inference features from prototype to production.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions as a senior individual contributor.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Marketing Data Science and Analytics team partners across Marketing, Strategic Finance, and Product to power data-driven growth. As a Senior Marketing Decision Scientist II, you will shape how we measure, forecast, and optimize marketing performance across channels, helping Instacart make smarter investment decisions and accelerate customer acquisition and retention.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role on a small, focused team where you will own complex, zero-to-one measurement initiatives and scale proven solutions. You will collaborate closely with channel marketers, growth leaders, finance partners, and data engineers to deliver models and experimentation frameworks that inform multi-million-dollar decisions. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment that still moves like a startup—and you love rolling up your sleeves to turn ambiguous questions into clear recommendations—this role is for you.

You’ll join a tight-knit immediate team of 5 within a broader 9-person marketing data science org, where there is real scope to set the bar for analytical rigor, build systems that last, and influence the roadmap. Come help us go far together by solving complex problems that grow the pie for our customers, retailers, and partners.

About the Job

  • Own the end-to-end marketing measurement strategy across paid search, paid social, display, affiliates, CTV, and lifecycle/CRM, unifying MMM, MTA, and incrementality testing to guide channel and portfolio-level investment.
  • Design, launch, and analyze experiments (e.g., geo tests, PSA tests, holdouts) and causal inference studies that quantify lift, inform targeting, and establish best practices for decision-making under uncertainty.
  • Build and productionize predictive models (e.g., LTV, churn/propensity, audience response, budget allocation) using SQL and Python or R, partnering with data engineering to automate pipelines and ensure data quality.
  • Create executive-ready dashboards and narratives in tools like Looker or Mode that track KPIs, explain performance drivers, and translate insights into clear, prioritized recommendations.
  • Partner with Strategic Finance and Marketing leadership on forecasting, scenario planning, and quarterly planning processes; influence roadmaps and present findings to VP+ stakeholders.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly in a dynamic environment, managing multiple concurrent projects and elevating the team’s analytical bar through peer reviews, documentation, and mentorship.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in marketing analytics or data science within technology, e-commerce, marketplace, or consumer subscription businesses.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and in either Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and modeling.
  • Hands-on experience designing and analyzing marketing experiments (e.g., A/B tests, geo experiments, holdouts) and applying causal inference techniques to estimate incrementality.
  • Proven track record implementing at least one marketing measurement approach (e.g., MMM, MTA, or structured incrementality testing) to inform budget allocation for multi-million-dollar programs.
  • Experience building business-facing dashboards and self-serve tools in Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
  • Experience working with modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) and version control (Git).
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical roadmaps and to communicate clear, actionable recommendations to non-technical and executive audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a quantitative discipline.
  • Experience building, validating, and operationalizing Marketing Mix Models (preferably Bayesian approaches using PyMC, Stan, or similar) and triangulating MMM with experiment results.
  • Familiarity with privacy-conscious measurement (e.g., conversion modeling, SKAN, clean rooms such as Amazon Marketing Cloud or Ads Data Hub) and ad platform APIs.
  • Experience with analytics engineering and pipeline tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow) and strong data QA practices.
  • Background in lifecycle/CRM analytics (e.g., uplift modeling, audience selection, message experimentation) and LTV forecasting.
  • Exposure to experimentation platforms and feature flagging (e.g., Optimizely or internal frameworks) and to ML applications for bidding, pacing, and creative optimization.
  • Experience mentoring peers and elevating analytical standards through code reviews, reproducible research, and documentation.

Beale Infrastructure Group is a rapidly growing developer and owner of next-generation digital infrastructure assets, focused on delivering hyperscale data center campuses for leading global technology companies. Backed by Blue Owl Capital’s Real Assets platform, Beale benefits from deep institutional capital, a disciplined investment approach, and an experienced leadership team with a proven track record in digital infrastructure development. The Company is in a high-growth phase, with an expanding pipeline of projects across key U.S. markets.

Purpose of the Position

The VP of Quality & Commissioning (VP QCx) is the executive lead responsible for the operational integrity, technical performance, and handover excellence of Beale’s global portfolio. This role is accountable for ensuring that every asset we deliver meets rigorous uptime requirements and is fully optimized from Day 1.

The VP provides the high-level strategy and organizational design for the QCx department. You are responsible for building a world-class internal team and a strategic network of third-party partners to ensure "Right First Time " delivery across all mission-critical projects.

    value).

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control.
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer.
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

About Us:

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role:

We are hiring aSenior Computer Vision Engineerto improve our computer vision system for construction documents. This role focuses on detection and segmentation quality, geometric accuracy, and production-grade pipelines that work reliably with messy real-world PDFs and drawings.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and improve end-to-end detection and segmentation pipelines for document images.
  • Improve document ingestion for PDFs and other unstructured files, including parsing, rendering, and handling of multi-page and multi-view content.
  • Increase model accuracy, boundary and geometric quality, and overall reliability of predictions for downstream use.
  • Integrate modern detection and segmentation models into production workflows and build the post-processing that turns model output into structured, usable geometry.
  • Define evaluation metrics, investigate failure cases, and drive continuous quality improvements.
  • Optimize latency, reliability, and cost across the inference and post-processing stack.
  • Own training infrastructure, dataset curation, annotation quality, and continuous-improvement loops.
  • Make architectural decisions and own system quality end to end.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years experience building computer vision systems: detection, segmentation, or structured geometry extraction, used high volume in production.
  • Experience working with messy, real-world image data or large unstructured visual datasets.
  • Strong understanding of detection and segmentation tradeoffs, including model architecture choices, training data design, and post-processing.
  • Ability to measure system performance with evaluation, testing, and production metrics.
  • Ability to explain failure modes clearly and improve systems through debugging, dataset work, and iteration.
  • Experience with multimodal models (vision-language models, document AI systems)
  • Understanding of grounding — linking model outputs to source data or coordinates
  • Backend engineering experience, including APIs, async processing, and scalable GPU services.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with polygon or mask post-processing, geometric regularization, or CAD-style structured output.
  • Experience with layout-aware document processing, PDF vector extraction, or combining raster and vector signals.
  • Background in document-heavy CV domains such as construction, real estate, medical imaging, geospatial, or similar workflows.
  • Experience optimizing inference cost and latency at scale.
  • Familiarity with open-source detection / segmentation ecosystems, training infrastructure, or model serving.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Accurate, geometrically correct predictions suitable for downstream measurement, and analysis use.
  • Fast, reliable inference across large and messy real-world document sets.
  • Clear quality metrics and a repeatable improvement loop.
  • Systems that perform consistently under real-world production constraints.

What This Role is Not:

  • Not a model-training-only role. You'll own data, training, post-processing, and serving.
  • Not a research-only role.
  • Not a plug-and-play CV tools environment.

Why Join STACK?

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
  • Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
  • Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

  • Radical Honesty:Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
  • Customer Obsession:Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
  • Move With Purpose:Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
  • Grow Together:Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United Kingdom. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. This role exists to close a capability gap: we have deep on-prem expertise, and we need a leader who can define and drive modern cloud standards, guide technical direction, and uplift the team.

You’ll operate as a technical lead with an architecture mindset: creating reference designs, setting guardrails, making pragmatic trade-offs (security, resilience, cost), and leading delivery across infrastructure and hybrid cloud. This is not a DevOps role, you will collaborate with DevOps and engineers, but your focus is infrastructure/platform, governance, reliability, and technical leadership.

Job Responsibilities:

Cloud & Hybrid Architecture (Azure & AWS)

  • Own the target-state hybrid cloud architecture and roadmap (12–24 months), aligning security, resilience, and cost requirements.
  • Define reference architectures and standards: landing zones, network patterns, identity patterns, logging/monitoring, backup/DR, and environment separation.
  • Lead design and implementation of secure cloud networking: VNets/VPCs, routing, VPN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, Private Link/Endpoints, load balancers, WAF where needed.
  • Own cloud governance foundations: subscriptions/accounts, management groups, RBAC, naming/tagging, logging, budgets and policy guardrails.

Modern Cloud Operations (Hands-on Leadership)

  • Ensure cloud platforms, services, and workloads remain on supported, secure versions; implement drift detection and lifecycle management.
  • Establish platform observability: Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry where used; improve alert quality and operational readiness.
  • Build and maintain backup/DR posture with tested RTO/RPO, runbooks, and regular restore/DR exercises.
  • Drive FinOps discipline: cost allocation, tagging compliance, rightsizing, reservations/savings plans, and cost anomaly detection.

Security, Governance & Incident Readiness

  • Ensure security controls are in place and effective (least privilege, secure baselines, encryption, key management, vulnerability/patch posture).
  • Log & telemetry onboarding: own onboarding of data/log sources and integration with the SIEM (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel/Splunk) in partnership with Security.
  • Lead incident response for infrastructure/cloud events: triage, investigation, reporting, RCA, and implementation of preventative controls and guardrails.
  • Manage, document, and audit configuration changes; champion “repeatable by design” changes and reduce configuration drift.

Wintel & Core Infrastructure Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership across core infrastructure services: Windows Server, AD DS, DNS/DHCP, certificates/PKI, and integration with Entra ID.
  • Guide virtualisation/storage teams (VMware/Hyper-V, SAN/storage) towards cloud-aligned standards for resilience, security, and lifecycle.

Leadership and Uplift

  • Act as the technical authority for infrastructure and hybrid cloud lead technical decisions and drive outcomes.
  • Mentor and upskill engineers on modern cloud infrastructure practices; run knowledge sessions and codify standards into reusable patterns.

Requirements

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Strong enterprise infrastructure background with a Wintel core (Windows Server, AD, DNS/DHCP, certificates) and operational discipline.
  • Demonstrable, hands-on Azure production experience including:
    • Identity/RBAC/Entra integration
    • VNets, VPN/ExpressRoute, Private Link/Endpoints
    • Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, backup/DR patterns, policy/guardrails
  • Working knowledge of AWS production environments (accounts/VPC, security groups, IAM basics, CloudWatch).
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident leadership across OS/network layers; confident with vendors/escalations.
  • Scripting/automation mindset (strong PowerShell; Bash/Python beneficial).
  • Ability to create architecture artefacts: reference designs, diagrams, standards, and decision records (ADRs).

Preferred CertificationsAZ-104 , AZ-305 or AZ-500

Desirable

  • Conditional Access and privileged access controls (PIM), break-glass patterns, Zero Trust principles.
  • Azure Policy/AWS Config, Defender for Cloud/Security Hub, GuardDuty; landing zone governance tooling.
  • AWS Control Tower, IAM Identity Center, CloudFormation (read/maintain).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code familiarity (Terraform/Bicep) preferred, but not essential.

SUPERP is een IT-consultancy partner die sinds 1999 het digitale hart van toonaangevende organisaties versterkt. Met meer dan 500 consultants bouwen we aan betrouwbare, toekomstbestendige Digital Core-systemen. We combineren de slagkracht van een grote speler met de betrokkenheid van een specialist. Als SAP Supply Chain Consultant maak je deel uit van ons SAP Core-team. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende specialismen en voert opdrachten uit bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Je taken omvatten onder andere:

Dankzij onze brede expertise vertrouwen klanten op SUPERP voor oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen jouw eigen domein. Dit betekent dat je meedenkt op strategisch niveau en écht impact maakt.

In twee gesprekken maak je kennis met je toekomstige teamleider, een salescollega en een teamgenoot. Heb je specifieke wensen over wie je wilt spreken? Laat het ons weten, dan maken we dat mogelijk!
