jobs.excerpt: Hi, we’re CompanyCam. We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries.
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

The camera is where CompanyCam starts. It’s the surface every contractor touches every day, and it’s the single highest-leverage piece of our product. As Principal Product Manager, Camera, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how contractors capture, organize, and get value from photos on the jobsite, setting direction for where the camera goes next as AI, computer vision, and automation become bigger parts of the story. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director of Product Management and leading through influence across Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Customer Success, and Support to move the highest-leverage problems from idea to shipped product.

Location: Candidates must permanently and currently reside in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the camera and photo experience, balancing core capture improvements with bigger bets in photo intelligence and workflow automation
  • Lead discovery with customers to understand how they capture, share, search, and use photos in the field, and turn what you learn into sharp, well-prioritized problem statements
  • Connect the camera to the rest of the platform: projects, documentation, reports, proposals, integrations, and communication
  • Partner with Engineering and Design to move from discovery to shipped work with speed and clarity, writing clear requirements and acceptance criteria along the way
  • Work with Engineering on the hard technical problems: device constraints, mobile performance, upload reliability, image quality, metadata, and offline behavior
  • Make smart tradeoffs on AI-powered features, balancing automation, user control, speed, and trust
  • Define and track the metrics that matter: adoption, capture behavior, upload success, workflow completion, retention, satisfaction, and business impact
  • Mentor other PMs and help raise the bar on discovery and outcome-focused execution across the product org

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

  • Shaping the roadmap for the most-used surface in our entire product, the camera every contractor touches every day
  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Customer Success, and Support around the highest-leverage problems worth solving
  • Making the daily job easier for contractors in the field, from faster capture to smarter, more useful photos
  • Setting the direction for how AI and automation show up responsibly across our whole platform

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping products that moved real customer and business metrics
  • Experience owning a high-usage product surface, mobile experience, or core workflow product
  • A history of taking products from concept through launch and iteration
  • Strong discovery, market research, and analytics skills used to set and prioritize strategy
  • A track record of working closely with Engineering and Design on technically complex areas
  • Experience with camera functionality, photo workflows, mobile capture, media management, computer vision, or device-based experiences
  • Experience shipping AI-powered, automation-based, or data-driven features
  • A bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, or a related field, preferred, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience building prototypes or working artifacts to test ideas quickly, preferred
  • B2B SaaS experience, preferred
  • A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
  • A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

Bonus Points

  • You're familiar with and have used the set of practices outlined in Continuous Discovery Habits by Teresa Torres
  • You've spent some portion of your career developing solutions for in-platform communications
  • Experience in the construction or contractor industry

About The Product Team

We have four principles:

  1. Holistic thinking: We know that nothing exists in a silo at a team, discipline, or feature level
  2. Proactive collaboration: We build context together and encourage synchronous, streamlined work from our colleagues and diversity in problem-solving
  3. Data-driven decision-making: We use first principles and are skeptical so we can get to the right answer to deliver value quickly
  4. Disciplined prioritization: We substantiate the size of the opportunity we're pursuing, ensuring it connects back to the squad’s outcomes and the business’s strategy

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $215,000-$235,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

Note: Resumes sent to this email will not be reviewed or responded to. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

jobs.title: Resource Management Director / Directeur(trice) de la gestion des ressources
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThe Resource Management Director is responsible for leading the organization's global resource planning strategy and ensuring optimal allocation of talent across all operational functions.
jobs.description:
Description

The Resource Management Director is responsible for leading the organization's global resource planning strategy and ensuring optimal allocation of talent across all operational functions. This role plays a critical part in balancing business demand, project requirements, workforce capacity, and organizational priorities to maximize utilization, operational efficiency, employee experience, and client delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operational Leaders across Clinical Trial Delivery, Data & Regulatory Sciences, and Scientific and Medical functions, and in collaboration with Finance and Human Resources, the Resource Management Director is responsible for developing workforce planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and resource allocation strategies to support sustainable growth and overall business objectives.

The Resource Management Director serves as a strategic advisor to the Global Head of Clinical Trial Delivery on workforce capacity, resource risks, and organizational readiness.

More specifically, the Resource Management Director must

Strategic Resource Planning

  • Define and drive the global resource management strategy aligned with corporate objectives and growth priorities.
  • Lead end-to-end resource planning frameworks supporting activities from proposal development through study close-out.
  • Establish scalable workforce planning timeframes (short-, mid-, and long-term) to ensure capacity readiness.
  • Translate business pipeline and strategic forecasts into forward-looking resource requirements.
  • Identify potential resource constraints early and implement proactive mitigation plans.
  • Partner with senior leadership to ensure resource strategies enable business expansion and delivery commitments.

Resource Allocation & Optimization

  • Lead resource allocation across projects, functions, and geographies to ensure effective deployment.
  • Balance business needs with employee engagement, development, and retention considerations.
  • Drive consistency and best practices in resource assignment decisions.
  • Optimize resource utilization through dynamic reallocation aligned with evolving priorities.
  • Enable cross-functional and cross-regional resource flexibility to maximize efficiency.
  • Incorporate financial rigor into resourcing decisions by considering cost drivers and margin dynamics, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, cost efficiency, and profitability objectives.

Forecasting & Analytics

  • Develop resource forecasting models and capacity planning tools.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor key workforce planning metrics and indicators to support effective resourcing decisions and optimize organizational performance.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and recommendations to operational leadership.
  • Analyze trends to improve workforce planning accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Support adoption of new tools and digital solutions that improve resource efficiency, resource oversight, and operational visibility (e.g., Power-BI and dashboards).

Workforce Planning & Talent Strategy

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to define hiring strategies aligned with projected demand.
  • Identify capability gaps and evolving skill requirements to inform workforce planning.
  • Support broader talent strategies, including succession planning and workforce development.
  • Collaborate with HR and operational leaders to enhance workforce effectiveness.

Operational Leadership & Governance

  • Establish and maintain governance processes for resource planning and allocation.
  • Lead structured resource review meetings with operational leadership.
  • Develop, standardize, and continuously improve resource management processes, systems, and tools.
  • Ensure resourcing practices support delivery excellence and employee engagement.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary resource planning partner for senior operational leaders.
  • Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
  • Build strong relationships across Operations, Finance, Human Resources, and Business Development.
  • Support strategic decision-making regarding organizational growth, restructuring, and expansion

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Project Management, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Master's degree is considered an asset.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in resource management, workforce planning, operations, project management, or related functions.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience
  • Experience in a CRO, life sciences, consulting, professional services, or matrixed global organization strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing complex resource allocation across multiple functions and geographies.
  • Strong strategic workforce planning skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical resource strategies.
  • Strong financial acumen including the ability to understand cost drivers, margin dynamics, and the financial impact of operational decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and profitability objectives.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and make evidence-based recommendations.
  • Ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Makes timely, balanced decisions using data, judgment, and business context.
  • Effectively communicates complex resource considerations to leaders at all organizational levels.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools and productivity platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar technologies) to support daily work activities and improve efficiency.
  • Comfortable working in evolving environments and adapting to new technologies, systems, and industry practices.
  • Proven ability to lead change management initiatives and influence cross-functional teams.

Our company

The Work Environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive opportunities for advancement.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, RRSP, vacation, personal days, virtual medical clinic, public transportation rebates, social activities)
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities

﻿Work Location

The successful candidate for this position has the option to work remotely anywhere in Canada, or from our headquarters in Montreal (in accordance with company policies and public health directives).

Occasional visits to our Montreal office may be required or encouraged.

﻿About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in clinical trials. Based in Montreal, we have built a strong reputation for the quality of our research and services that exceed client expectations. Indero continues to grow and expand across North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment and selection process for applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Please note that Indero only accepts applicants who are legally authorized to work in Canada.

Description de poste

Le/La Directeur(trice) de la gestion des ressources est responsable de diriger la stratégie mondiale de planification des ressources de l’organisation et d’assurer une allocation optimale des talents au sein de l’ensemble des fonctions opérationnelles. Ce rôle joue un rôle essentiel dans l’équilibre entre les besoins de l’entreprise, les exigences des projets, la capacité de la main-d’œuvre et les priorités organisationnelles, afin de maximiser l’utilisation des ressources, l’efficacité opérationnelle, l’expérience employé et la prestation de services aux clients.

En étroite collaboration avec les leaders opérationnels des secteurs de la prestation des essais cliniques, des sciences des données et des affaires réglementaires ainsi que des fonctions scientifiques et médicales, et en partenariat avec les équipes des Finances et des Ressources humaines, le/la Directeur(trice) de la gestion des ressources est responsable de développer des cadres de planification de la main-d’œuvre, des méthodologies de prévision et des stratégies d’allocation des ressources afin de soutenir une croissance durable et les objectifs globaux de l’entreprise.

Le/La Directeur(trice) de la gestion des ressources agit également à titre de conseiller(ère) stratégique auprès du/de la Responsable mondial(e) de la prestation des essais cliniques relativement à la capacité de la main-d’œuvre, aux risques liés aux ressources et à la préparation organisationnelle.

﻿Plus précisément, le/la Directeur(trice) de la gestion des ressources doit :

﻿Planification stratégique des ressources

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie mondiale de gestion des ressources en l’alignant sur les objectifs organisationnels et les priorités de croissance.
  • Diriger les cadres de planification des ressources de bout en bout, depuis l’élaboration des propositions jusqu’à la clôture des études.
  • Établir des horizons de planification de la main-d’œuvre évolutifs à court, moyen et long terme afin d’assurer une capacité adéquate.
  • Traduire le portefeuille d’opportunités commerciales et les prévisions stratégiques en besoins futurs en ressources.
  • Identifier rapidement les contraintes potentielles en matière de ressources et mettre en œuvre des plans d’atténuation proactifs.
  • Collaborer avec la haute direction afin de s’assurer que les stratégies de ressources soutiennent la croissance de l’entreprise et le respect des engagements de livraison.

﻿Allocation et optimisation des ressources

  • Diriger l’allocation des ressources entre les projets, les fonctions et les régions afin d’assurer un déploiement efficace des talents.
  • Équilibrer les besoins de l’entreprise avec les considérations liées à l’engagement, au développement et à la rétention des employés.
  • Favoriser la cohérence et l’adoption de pratiques exemplaires dans les décisions d’affectation des ressources.
  • Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources grâce à une réallocation dynamique en fonction de l’évolution des priorités.
  • Favoriser la flexibilité des ressources entre les fonctions et les régions afin de maximiser l’efficacité.
  • Intégrer une rigueur financière aux décisions de dotation en ressources en tenant compte des facteurs de coûts et des dynamiques de marge, afin d’assurer l’alignement avec les priorités organisationnelles ainsi que les objectifs d’efficacité des coûts et de rentabilité.

﻿Prévisions et analyses

  • Développer des modèles de prévision des ressources et des outils de planification de la capacité.
  • Développer, maintenir et suivre les principaux indicateurs et mesures de planification de la main-d’œuvre afin de soutenir des décisions efficaces en matière de ressources et d’optimiser la performance organisationnelle.
  • Fournir à la direction opérationnelle des rapports, des analyses et des recommandations de niveau exécutif.
  • Analyser les tendances afin d’améliorer la précision de la planification de la main-d’œuvre et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Soutenir l’adoption de nouveaux outils et de solutions numériques permettant d’améliorer l’efficacité de la gestion des ressources, la supervision des capacités et la visibilité opérationnelle, notamment Power BI et les tableaux de bord.

﻿Planification de la main-d’œuvre et stratégie de talents

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’Acquisition de talents afin de définir des stratégies d’embauche alignées sur la demande prévue.
  • Identifier les écarts de compétences et l’évolution des besoins en matière d’expertise afin d’orienter la planification de la main-d’œuvre.
  • Soutenir les stratégies globales de gestion des talents, notamment la planification de la relève et le développement de la main-d’œuvre.
  • Collaborer avec les Ressources humaines et les leaders opérationnels afin d’améliorer l’efficacité de la main-d’œuvre.

﻿Leadership opérationnel et gouvernance

  • Établir et maintenir des processus de gouvernance liés à la planification et à l’allocation des ressources.
  • Diriger des rencontres structurées de revue des ressources avec les leaders opérationnels.
  • Développer, standardiser et améliorer continuellement les processus, systèmes et outils de gestion des ressources.
  • S’assurer que les pratiques de gestion des ressources soutiennent l’excellence opérationnelle ainsi que l’engagement des employés.

﻿Gestion des parties prenantes

  • Agir comme principal partenaire en matière de planification des ressources auprès des hauts dirigeants opérationnels.
  • Influencer la prise de décision au moyen de recommandations fondées sur les données.
  • Développer de solides relations de collaboration avec les équipes des Opérations, des Finances, des Ressources humaines et du Développement des affaires.
  • Soutenir la prise de décisions stratégiques liées à la croissance organisationnelle, aux restructurations et à l’expansion de l’entreprise.

Profil recherché

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Project Management, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Master's degree is considered an asset.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in resource management, workforce planning, operations, project management, or related functions.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience
  • Experience in a CRO, life sciences, consulting, professional services, or matrixed global organization strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing complex resource allocation across multiple functions and geographies.
  • Strong strategic workforce planning skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical resource strategies.
  • Strong financial acumen including the ability to understand cost drivers, margin dynamics, and the financial impact of operational decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and profitability objectives.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and make evidence-based recommendations.
  • Ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Makes timely, balanced decisions using data, judgment, and business context.
  • Effectively communicates complex resource considerations to leaders at all organizational levels.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools and productivity platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar technologies) to support daily work activities and improve efficiency.
  • Comfortable working in evolving environments and adapting to new technologies, systems, and industry practices.
  • Proven ability to lead change management initiatives and influence cross-functional teams.

Notre entreprise

L’environnement de travail

Chez Indero, vous travaillerez avec des collègues compétents et dynamiques. Nos valeurs sont la collaboration, l’innovation, la fiabilité et la réactivité. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant ainsi que de belles perspectives d’évolution professionnelle.

Dans ce poste, vous bénéficierez des conditions suivantes :

  • Horaire de travail flexible
  • Poste permanent à temps plein
  • Gamme complète d’avantages sociaux (assurances médicales, dentaires, vision, régime de retraite, vacances, journées personnelles, clinique médicale virtuelle, rabais sur le transport en commun, activités sociales)
  • Formation et développement continu

﻿Lieu de travail

La personne embauchée pourra travailler à distance de n’importe quelle ville au Canada, ou depuis notre bureau principal à Montréal (conformément aux politiques de l’entreprise et aux directives de santé publique).

Des visites occasionnelles à notre siège social pourraient être requises ou encouragées.

﻿À propos d’Indero

Indero est une entreprise de recherche clinique contractuelle (CRO) spécialisée dans les essais cliniques. Depuis ses débuts, notre entreprise à taille humaine s’est forgé une solide réputation pour la qualité de ses recherches et de ses services, surpassant les attentes de nos clients. Basée à Montréal, Indero poursuit sa croissance à travers l’Amérique du Nord et l’Europe.

Indero s’engage à offrir un traitement équitable et des chances égales à tous les candidats. Des accommodements peuvent être offerts à toute étape du processus de recrutement pour les personnes en situation de handicap, sur demande.

Indero n’accepte que les candidatures de personnes légalement autorisées à travailler au Canada.

Le genre masculin est utilisé sans discrimination, dans le seul but d’alléger le texte.

jobs.excerpt: About CollectlyCollectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation.
jobs.description:
About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.
Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience; enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.
There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation as it has a clear and demonstrable ROI to our customers.

About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Data Analyst to own how customers and our own teams see product performance. You will work both on our pre-service products (visit cost estimates, eligibility and benefits, patient support voice agent) and post-service (patient billing, revenue cycle metrics). You’ll
own the dashboards for these products, provide visibility into our product performance, and use the data to find product gaps.

You’ll build customer-facing metrics yourself, mostly with AI tools like Claude Code. This is a product role more than an infrastructure one: we want your time going into how each product behaves and what customers run into, not into maintaining pipelines.

We are a hybrid company, partly based in Santa Monica, USA and partly remote, spread out around the United States & Europe.

Key responsibilities

    In this role you will

  • Own the dashboards that product and customer teams work from, across most of our products.
  • Turn complaints and open questions into defined metrics, and track them over time.
  • Catch product issues in the data before they become escalations.
  • Work with the founder, product managers, engineers, and customer success to decide what to measure, and explain why a number moved.

Required qualifications

    Must-haves

Job Description

The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) has an outstanding opportunity for an Assistant Director, Media to join their team.

About this Opportunity

Reporting to the Director of Communications, the Assistant Director, Media is responsible for managing the Media team and leading media relations work — developing media materials, pitching IHME’s research to journalists, responding to inquiries, and coordinating researcher interviews. This is a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to evolving news cycles, and lead a team with confidence and clarity under pressure.

The role develops and executes strategies to drive global media coverage of IHME’s work, growing earned media and owned platforms including the Global Health Insights (GHI) podcast and newsletter. This requires strong people and project management skills and the ability to cultivate strategic relationships with journalists, media outlets, and — as needed — external communications firms and consultants, to reach policymakers, donors, and other stakeholders worldwide. The Assistant Director, Media identifies, creates, and disseminates high-quality, policy-relevant stories and uses analytics to measure and refine that outreach.

Office is located in Seattle, Washington. This position is eligible to work fully remote; work schedule required to overlap 50% of IHME Office hours between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. Pacific Time.

Key Responsibilities

Media strategy – 30%

  • Strategically manage and expand IHME’s network of global media contacts, key opinion leaders, policymakers, and other stakeholders; proactively identify opportunities for new relationships and strengthen relationships with journalists to disseminate IHME’s evidence-based research effectively and seek to impact global health policy.
  • Ensure inquiries and requests from journalists for findings and interviews with experts in IHME’s research network are handled in a timely and professional way.
  • Oversee and provide media training to faculty and staff to help them prepare for interviews.
  • Develop and execute creative strategies to build owned media platforms, including podcast and newsletter.
  • Manage relationships with communications firms and external consultants when necessary.
  • Serve as a spokesperson for IHME if necessary.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

Team management – 25%

  • Supervise employees, to include hiring and training, assigning work hours, managing workflow, priority setting, contributing to professional growth and ensuring team members have the clarity and guidance needed to be accountable for producing high-quality, accurate work.
  • Create and manage work plans for team members, hold regular check-ins to monitor work progress, answer questions, and troubleshoot as needed.
  • Provide direction, coaching, and support, ensuring team members have the clarity and guidance needed to be accountable for their work.
  • Ensure the team delivers to the highest standards of the organization in terms of accuracy in its work.
  • Assess and map project deliverables to resource needs.

Writing, outreach, and analytics – 25%

  • Work with faculty and staff to transform complex research into compelling and policy-relevant messages that are comprehensible to targeted non-scientific audiences.
  • Oversee the development of all outreach products including press releases, media advisories, pitches, messaging briefs, fact sheets, podcast, and newsletters.
  • Manage compilation and reporting of KPIs (key performance indicators) and creation of reports and slides for IHME’s Senior Management Team, Board, and other stakeholders.

Knowledge command – 20%

  • Develop in-depth familiarity with media organizations and journalists around the world, including their political and cultural contexts.
  • Regularly review the landscape of international media coverage on a range of population health, global development, and other health-related topics including business, economics, and technology to identify ways for IHME’s work to be woven into the global dialogue.
  • Recognize, assess, and address risks and crisis situations that could potentially affect IHME’s reputation and brand.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Department.

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or related field plus 10 to 15 years of experience in a role or roles in media relations, public relations, or a combination of work in journalism and communications with internal and external stakeholders and influential organizations and individuals.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong management and leadership capabilities, demonstrated through supervising and developing the work of staff members, freelancers, and/or external vendors — or through leading projects.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to foster productive relationships with colleagues at all levels of the organization including senior leadership, external partners, and the Institute’s third-party service providers.
  • Professional maturity and sound judgment, with the adaptability to navigate change and a solutions-oriented mindset, working both independently and collaboratively to achieve objectives.
  • Ability to take technical and highly scientific research and make it relevant, clear, and concise for the public.
  • Superb time management skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple work streams, shifting priorities, and time-sensitive deadlines while keeping the team accountable and on track.
  • Committed to a focus on accountability and delivering results while able to meet ongoing deadlines including those that are time sensitive.Comfortable learning and using AI tools as part of daily workflow as appropriate, with an openness to adopting new technologies that improve team efficiency and content quality.
  • Creative, strategic thinker with project management experience translating ideas into well-executed plans.
  • Excellent communications skills, both written and oral.
  • Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, commitment to accuracy and high-quality work.
  • Aptitude for public speaking before large and small audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience with media relations, including developing media materials (press releases, media advisories, pitches, and messaging briefs), conducting proactive media outreach, and responding to media inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Experience supervising, leading, or mentoring junior colleagues and actively supporting their professional growth and development — whether as a formal people manager or as a team lead.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Substantive knowledge of public health research and policy, data science, and other related research fields.
  • Ability to work with academic researchers and comprehend peer-reviewed health research.
  • Prior experience transforming statistical information into compelling written and spoken content targeted at a general audience.
  • Proficiency in more than one language to lead dissemination of multilingual media materials.

Working Conditions

  • This position works with a global network of stakeholders, as such evening and weekend work may be required to fulfill job duties.
  • Travel may be required up to 30% of the year, both domestic and international.
  • Office is located in Seattle, Washington. This position is eligible to work fully remote; work schedule required to overlap 50% of IHME Office hours between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. Pacific Time.
  • Valid passport or the ability to obtain one is required.

Additional Application Requirement

This recruitment requires references and a cover letter. Applications that do not include a this will not be forwarded to the hiring department.

Please attach a cover letter to you application:

  • Please provide three references in your cover letter with at least one reference being a past or present supervisor.

About the Team

The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) is an independent research organization at the University of Washington (UW). Its mission is to deliver to the world timely, relevant, and scientifically valid evidence to improve health policy and practice. IHME carries out its mission through a range of projects within different research areas including the Global Burden of Diseases (GBD), Injuries, and Risk Factors; Future Health Scenarios; Cost Effectiveness and Efficiency; Resource Tracking; and Impact Evaluations.

The Global Impact Group (GIG) serves IHME’s vision of all people living long lives in full health through innovative communication and collaboration. GIG explains, amplifies, and delivers research findings of the most critical health challenges across a range of channels to reach its target audiences, working with scientists and decision-makers to strengthen the evidence base of research, allowing them to take informed action. Within GIG, the Media team promotes IHME’s research, faculty, staff, and its products through media outreach and stakeholder engagement that’s timely, newsworthy, and engaging to a broad range of audiences.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.excerpt: VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization.
jobs.description:
VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization. Large banks, aspiring fintechs, and growing merchants embed our universal token vault into their technology stack to manage the complexities of payment data tokenization across processors and networks, open banking, card issuance, omnichannel loyalty, PCI compliance, payment orchestration, and more. We empower our clients and partners by tokenizing sensitive payment data, limiting compliance scope, and consolidating payments to unlock revenue and business opportunities.

VGS provides processor-agnostic tokenization solutions via secure universal token vaults, iframes, mobile SDKs, tokenization proxies, APIs, and data orchestration tooling to support payment acceptance, card issuance, PII and bank account tokenization, and other payments value-added services. Some of the use cases we enable include multi-processor Network Tokenization, Account Updater, payment orchestration, secure settlement file processing, 3DS, and Risk provider connectivity.

The majority of this role is hands-on technical work: debugging, troubleshooting network and integration issues, onboarding new customers, and resolving tickets.

The remainder is operational ownership and cross-team coordination. The support team plays a vital role in translating between our Engineering and Go-To-Market teams (including account management and sales). During incidents, outages, escalations, and planned maintenance, you are the primary on-shift decision-maker for PT business hours: you decide whether an incident goes on the public status page, approve the wording of customer notifications, set maintenance timing, and coordinate as needed with the GTM teams so that they are aware of any impacts to their clients. These decisions sit with leadership today, and we want them to be owned within Support.

They come up infrequently but are time-sensitive and customer-visible. You'll have a written scope of what you can approve independently and what requires the manager, expanding as you establish a track record.

What you will be doing at VGS (Responsibilities)...

  • Serve as the senior decision-maker for the Support team during PT business hours. Escalations, judgment calls, and approvals land with you. You're the person on shift with the standing to decide, not to route.

  • Own incident and maintenance communications. Assess severity and customer impact, decide when to post to the public status page, write or approve the wording, including team drafts, and keep it up to date through resolution.

  • Set and coordinate maintenance timing. Choose windows based on real customer traffic patterns and regional load, negotiate them with engineering, inform internal client-facing teams about and make sure the notice goes out with enough lead time for customers to plan.

  • Coordinate multi-team projects where Support is a stakeholder: migrations, deprecations, launches, and customer-specific rollouts. Track dependencies and keep the parties honest about status.

  • Debug deeply. Reproduce issues with cURL and Postman, read logs, and trace requests across VGS infrastructure, customer systems, and downstream gateways. Diagnose network problems independently: DNS, TCP/IP, routing, timeouts, connection resets, and TLS/SSL handshake failures.

  • Resolve an issue, find a workaround, or escalate with a bug report good enough for engineering to act on immediately.

  • Drive mid-tier and long tail customer integrations from kickoff to go-live, coordinating between customer engineers and internal teams.

  • Write up nontrivial investigations as internal runbooks or public documentation.

  • Prepare and deliver customer training, building the material where it doesn't exist.

  • Meet SLA and quality targets, and help the team meet theirs.

  • Participate in the weekend on-call rotation (every 3rd weekend, Saturday and Sunday, 8:00–20:00 PT). On-call is monitoring coverage, not a full working day — you respond to urgent incidents and time-sensitive requests, while routine tickets wait for the next business day.

What we are looking for from you (Requirements)...

  • 5+ years in Technical Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, or Technical Project Management — with at least some of it in a senior or lead capacity.

  • Experience owning customer-facing incident or maintenance communication. You will be writing status page updates, incident notices, and escalation emails. You understand the difference between transparency and alarm.

  • Strong internal communication skills. You will be the translation layer between customers, VGS account management, and VGS product and engineering. You should be able to operate in different contexts and understand how to translate between the technical, operations, and business contexts of conversations to ensure context is not lost between stakeholders.

  • Autonomy. You are comfortable deciding and then reporting, rather than checking first. You'll have a few hours of overlap with your manager each day and spend the rest of your shift as the main decision-maker.

  • Strong command of HTTP, REST APIs, and proxies.

  • Independent network debugging — DNS, TCP/IP, routing, connectivity, TLS/SSL handshakes. Be ready to describe a specific problem you diagnosed and how you narrowed it down.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken. You'll be writing text that customers and executives read, under time pressure.

  • Willingness to work PT business hours on a sustained basis.


    • Nice to have

  • Payments background: acquirers, issuers, gateways, network tokenization, 3DS, PCI-DSS, SOC 2.

  • Reading and debugging code in at least one of Python, Go, Java, or a similar language. You won't ship production code.

  • A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree.

What you get from us...

• Flexible work hours and flexible PTO
• Competitive health benefits
• VGS stock options
• 401k plan, with employer matching 4% and immediate vesting (available only for US employees)
• Life & disability insurance
• Pre-tax flexible spending accounts, dependent and healthcare FSA (available only for US employees)
• Global parental leave program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Home Internet reimbursement
• New hire home office set-up allowance
• Professional learning reimbursement
At VGS, we have a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you’ll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time—because we know there’s real value in coming together.
We’re not about being in the office every day—but we are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Wer wir sind

Als eines von Europas führenden InsurTechs, mit starken Partnern wie Allianz X, Portage und White Star Capital im Rücken, ist unser Antrieb ganz einfach: Wir schützen die Welt unserer Kund:innen. Dein Impact

Bei CLARK wirst du Teil einer Kultur, die von Einfachheit, Verlässlichkeit und echter Wertschätzung geprägt ist. Wir bieten dir das Spielfeld – du sorgst für den Impact. Wir stellen keine Expert:innen ein, um den Status quo zu halten, wir suchen Talente, die uns aufs nächste Level bringen. Bist du bereit, das Spielfeld zu betreten?

So kannst du unsere gemeinsame Reise als CRM Manager(m/w/d) aktiv mitgestalten:

Deine Aufgaben

Als CRM Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du eng mit unseren Teams aus den Bereichen Marketing, Brand, Sales, Tech, Operations und Service zusammen, um wirkungsvolle CRM-Strategien für Deutschland, die Schweiz und das Vereinigte Königreich zu gestalten und umzusetzen.
Darüber hinaus unterstützt du uns in einem dynamischen Umfeld bei der Harmonisierung unserer CRM-Systeme, mit dem Ziel, ein effizientes und zukunftsfähiges CRM-Framework zu etablieren.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • End-to-End Verantwortung für CRM Performance mit klarem Fokus auf Business Impact (z. B. Engagement, Conversion, Umsatzbeitrag entlang des Funnels)
  • Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung einer skalierbaren CRM-Strategie über alle Lifecycle-Phasen hinweg
  • Konzeption, Implementierung und Optimierung von komplexen, datengetriebenen Customer Journeys (Multi-Channel: E-Mail, Push, In-App, SMS)
  • Eigenständige Steuerung und Priorisierung von CRM-Initiativen basierend auf Business Cases und Performance-Daten
  • Nutzung von Daten zur Identifikation von Wachstumshebeln im Funnel sowie Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen
  • Planung, Durchführung und Weiterentwicklung einer strukturierten Testing- und Optimierungsstrategie (A/B-Testing, Segmentierung, Personalisierung)
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der CRM-Systemlandschaft (insbesondere Salesforce Marketing Cloud) inkl. Automatisierung, Datenstruktur und Skalierbarkeit
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Sales, Data, Tech und Operations zur Orchestrierung einer konsistenten, kanalübergreifenden Kundenkommunikation
  • Beobachtung von Markttrends (insbesondere im Bereich AI & Automation) und Bewertung ihrer Relevanz für CLARK

Das bringts du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-/Lifecycle-Marketing (idealerweise 6+ Jahre) mit klarem Fokus auf Business Impact (Conversion, Umsatz, Engagement)
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe, mehrstufige Customer Journeys eigenständig zu konzipieren und zu optimieren
  • Umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit Salesforce Marketing Cloud – insbesondere in der Umsetzung von automatisierten Journeys
  • Verständnis für Datenstrukturen und ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten zur Interpretation von CRM-Daten und Ableitung strategischer Maßnahmen
  • Praktische Erfahrungen in der AI-gestützten Analyse, Umsetzung oder Automatisierung von CRM-Kampagnen
  • Routiniert darin, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mehrere Prioritäten und Stakeholder gleichzeitig souverän zu managen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sichere Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Benefits - Warum CLARK

Bei CLARK arbeitest du nicht nur, du gestaltest aktiv mit. Damit du dein Bestes geben kannst, unterstützen wir dich mit einem Paket, das Flexibilität, Sicherheit und persönliches Wachstum vereint.

Wir geben dir echte Wahlfreiheit und Autonomie:

  • Arbeite 100 % remote oder in einem hybriden Setup aus unseren modernen Büros in Deutschland.

  • 30 Urlaubstage, plus jeweils einen halben Tag extra am 24. und 31. Dezember.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, damit du deinen Arbeitstag so strukturieren kannst, wie es am besten in dein Leben passt.Wir investieren in dich, fachlich und persönlich:
  • 2 bezahlte Impact Days pro Jahr zur Unterstützung deines ehrenamtlichen oder gesellschaftlichen Engagements.
  • Ein breites Angebot an Entwicklungsformaten, darunter Hackathons, Leadership-Programme, interne Trainings und monatliche Lunch & Learn Sessions.
  • Zugang zu internen und externen Lern- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Teamspirit: Quartalsweise Workshops und jährliche globale Events stärken unseren Zusammenhalt über die Landesgrenzen hinweg.Damit du den Kopf frei hast und dich auf die wirklich wichtigen Dinge konzentrieren kannst:
  • Attraktive Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
  • Exklusive Mitarbeiterangebote und Partner-Rabatte.Bei CLARK kannst du einfach du selbst sein! Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und gegenseitiger Respekt sind für uns keine leeren Phrasen: Sie sind fest darin verankert, wie wir zusammenarbeiten und wie wir Entscheidungen treffen.

Die ausgeschriebene Position wird gemäß unserer internen Vergütungsstruktur mit einem Jahresbruttogehalt zwischen 55.000 € und 75.000 € vergütet, abhängig von Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung.

This role is particularly suited to a practising Data Analytics professional who is passionate about education, mentoring, and developing the next generation of data talent.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and deliver engaging live webinars, masterclasses, and learning sessions aligned with Data Analytics subject areas and course objectives.

  • Work collaboratively with learner support colleagues to identify engagement challenges and help learners remain connected to their learning objectives and course progression.
  • Maintain current knowledge of Data Analytics practices, tools, industry developments, and emerging trends to ensure facilitation remains relevant to contemporary professional practice.

  • Minimum of 6 years of substantial professional Data Analytics experience, with experience across multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle.

  • Current professional experience in a Data Analytics or closely related role, with the ability to explain how analytical concepts are applied in real business environments.
  • Demonstrated teaching, facilitation, coaching, or mentoring capability, ideally with professional, postgraduate, or advanced adult learners.

Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.

Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.

The opportunity to use your professional Data Analytics expertise to support the development of emerging talent.

Exposure to a globally distributed learning environment and learners from varied professional backgrounds.

jobs.description:
KPFF Consulting Engineers is seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Talent Acquisition team and support hiring across multiple offices and disciplines throughout the firm.

This is a full-cycle recruiting role for someone who enjoys both the relationship-building and hands-on sides of talent acquisition. You will partner directly with hiring managers and operational leaders to understand their needs, develop recruiting strategies, identify and engage talent, manage searches, and help teams make informed hiring decisions.

Because KPFF operates through independently managed offices, recruiting does not always look the same from one team to the next. Success in this role requires curiosity, adaptability, strong judgment, and the ability to provide structure and guidance without taking a one-size-fits-all approach.

You will also be part of a collaborative Talent Acquisition team that shares ideas, resources, market insights, and responsibility for continually improving how we recruit across the firm.

What You'll Be Doing

Full-Cycle Recruiting & Sourcing

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for positions across multiple offices, disciplines, and experience levels, from intake and recruiting strategy through offer acceptance.
  • Partner with hiring teams to understand business needs, role requirements, candidate profiles, timelines, and market considerations before launching a search.
  • Develop sourcing and outreach strategies based on the role, location, talent market, and hiring team's needs.
  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, SmartRecruiters, professional networks, and other sourcing tools.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.
  • Manage job postings, applicant flow, candidate communication, interviews, feedback, references, and other recruiting activities within SmartRecruiters.

Consulting & Hiring Team Partnership

  • Serve as a recruiting partner to hiring managers and operational leaders, providing market insight, recruiting recommendations, and practical guidance throughout the hiring process.
  • Adapt recruiting strategies to support independently operating teams while bringing consistency and best practices where they add value.
  • Help hiring teams define candidate profiles, evaluate talent markets, and adjust recruiting approaches when searches require a different strategy.
  • Balance multiple concurrent searches and priorities while maintaining communication with hiring teams and candidates.
  • Partner with administrative and operational staff to coordinate recruiting activities and keep searches moving efficiently.
  • Use recruiting data, candidate feedback, and market information to identify opportunities to improve recruiting strategies and processes.

Candidate Experience & Collaboration

  • Build relationships with prospective candidates through thoughtful, personalized outreach and ongoing engagement.
  • Guide candidates through the recruiting process with clear, timely communication and an understanding of each team's opportunity and culture.
  • Help hiring teams create an organized, engaging, and responsive interview experience.
  • Work closely with other Talent Acquisition team members to share talent, sourcing strategies, market knowledge, and recruiting best practices.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in recruiting tools, processes, candidate engagement, and hiring team support.
  • 2 to 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within professional services, consulting, engineering, architecture, construction, technology, or another technical environment.
  • Demonstrated experience sourcing and engaging passive candidates, including strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and ATS or CRM databases.
  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and develop recruiting strategies.
  • Comfortable managing multiple searches with different priorities, stakeholders, and timelines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop effective candidate outreach and communicate confidently with candidates and hiring teams.
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with attention to both the candidate experience and the details required to keep searches moving.
  • Experience working with an Applicant Tracking System. Experience with SmartRecruiters is a plus.
  • Comfortable using recruiting data and market information to evaluate sourcing effectiveness and inform recruiting strategies.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in an environment where teams may have different processes, priorities, and decision-making styles.
  • Curious, collaborative, and comfortable asking questions, offering recommendations, and building trusted relationships with hiring teams.
  • Familiarity with AEC roles, terminology, or talent markets is helpful, but direct AEC recruiting experience is not required.

Work Environment & Flexibility

This is a work-from-home position, not a location-independent position. Candidates must be based in the United States and able to work standard business hours aligned with the Pacific or Mountain Time Zones.

Team members may work from home within these time zones or, when geographically close to a KPFF office, may have the option to work onsite or in a hybrid arrangement. Occasional travel for team meetings, recruiting activities, and office visits may be required.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Primarily a work-from-home role requiring prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, and participation in virtual meetings.
  • Requires a reliable internet connection and a professional environment appropriate for virtual meetings and candidate conversations.
  • Regular use of standard office technology, including a computer, headset, phone, and video conferencing tools.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in virtual and in-person settings.
  • For team members working onsite or in a hybrid arrangement, standard office environments and equipment apply.
  • Occasional travel may be required.

Compensation

  • Mettre en place les mécanismes de reporting, de suivi et de gouvernance.
  • Superviser les intégrations entre les systèmes européens et les plateformes nationales.
  • Diriger la préparation opérationnelle, les phases de test et les déploiements.
  • Assurer le suivi de la sécurité, des audits et des évaluations de conformité.

Business Intelligence et analytique

  • Définir les orientations BI ainsi que les KPI pertinents.
  • Superviser la création et l’évolution de tableaux de bord exécutifs et opérationnels.
  • Traduire les besoins métiers en indicateurs, rapports et analyses exploitables.
  • Garantir la gouvernance, la cohérence et la qualité des données.
  • Travailler avec des outils tels que Power BI, ainsi qu’avec d’autres solutions de visualisation et de reporting lorsque nécessaire.

Expertise ELK et observabilité

  • Définir et superviser l’architecture Elasticsearch, y compris la rétention des données et la performance.
  • Encadrer l’ingestion et la transformation des données via Logstash.
  • Concevoir et suivre les dashboards, le monitoring et le reporting dans Kibana.
  • Mettre en place des approches d’observabilité, de détection d’anomalies et d’analyse de tendances.

Environnement technique

  • Bonne maîtrise de l’ELK Stack : Elasticsearch, Logstash et Kibana.
  • Expérience avec Linux, Windows Server, Docker, APIs et environnements cloud hybrides.
  • Connaissance des pratiques DevOps, CI/CD et de la gestion des secrets via Vault ou un outil équivalent, y compris Enterprise Vault si applicable dans l’environnement.
  • Solide compréhension des plateformes européennes à grande échelle : EES, SIS, VIS, ETIAS et composants d’interopérabilité.

📝 Votre profile

  • Master en informatique, en ingénierie ou expérience équivalente.
  • Minimum 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets IT.
  • Une expérience confirmée d’au moins 5 ans dans des environnements gouvernementaux, liés à la sécurité ou à des infrastructures critiques constitue un atout important.
  • Connaissance approfondie des systèmes EES, VIS, SIS, ETIAS et de leur interopérabilité.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication, de coordination et de gestion des parties prenantes.
  • Expérience attendue en tant qu’IT Project Manager senior sur des contextes complexes et multi-acteurs.

Langues

  • Français, néerlandais et anglais courants, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Network Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support enterprise-scale cloud and hybrid network infrastructure environments. This position requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering capability, and the ability to operate effectively in complex multi-cloud enterprise environments.

Cloud & Network Architecture

• Programming Foundation: Introductory knowledge of Python (coursework, bootcamp, or self-study) and a strong eagerness to learn Robot Framework for test automation and orchestration.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with other technologists to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.

Alpine, an ITW company, is a leading provider of industry solutions and increased business productivity for component manufacturers helping design and manufacture the highest quality roof, floor and wall components. Our comprehensive product suite includes software, engineering services, connector plates, equipment and premier cold-formed steel truss system.

Job Description:

In Alpine’s Agile software development environment, the Product Owner (PO) is the key role to ensure product priorities and product roadmaps are executed. The PO develops and executes on a vision for the product and is responsible for translating that vision to actions for the scrum teams. The PO collaborates with internal stakeholders including Product Management, Marketing, Support, Operations, and Engineering to ensure that business, quality, and functional goals are met with each product release. The PO is responsible for the design, usability, quality, and delivery of a product or feature. The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and works to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each stage of the development lifecycle. The PO understands both the technical and business side of the product release and is ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Roadmap Execution & Delivery

    • Own execution of the product roadmap established by Product Manager for a specific focus area or product line

    • Translate strategic direction from Product Managers into clear, actionable development plans

    • Partner with Development Managers to manage sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release scope

  • Customer-Back Innovation (CBI)

    • Apply ITW’s Customer-Back Innovation (CBI) framework to identify and prioritize customer pain points

    • Translate insights into product requirements and features

    • Validate concepts directly with users and iterate based on feedback

  • Backlog & Requirements Management

    • Create and maintain clear, concise user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria

    • Ensure the backlog remains prioritized, refined, and ahead of development needs

    • Collaborate with UX/UI teams to align designs with user needs and business objectives

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, QA, Development, and UI/UX Design teams on a daily basis

    • Facilitate agile events (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives)

    • Coordinate with support and implementation teams to ensure successful releases

  • Domain & Industry Expertise

    • Develop subject matter expertise in component manufacturing workflows

    • Gain hands-on understanding of how customers use Alpine tools (e.g., design software, manufacturing software, and manufacturing equipment)

    • Observe real-world usage to inform product decisions

  • Quality & Delivery Assurance

    • Ensure delivered features meet acceptance criteria and customer expectations

    • Support user acceptance testing (UAT), documentation, and release readiness

    • Oversee beta trials with customers to validate product value and usability

  • Communication & Advocacy

    • Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to the organization by presenting at monthly CBI gate meetings

    • Advocate for the customer within development teams

    • Maintain transparency into sprint outcomes, priorities, and roadmap progress

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus – Making customers and their needs a primary focus of one’s actions; developing and sustaining productive customer relationships.

  • Communication – Strong ability to communicate vision and strategy to a variety of stakeholders including customers, leadership, and the development teams.

  • Business Savvy – As the key decision maker for the project, the Product Owner must use understanding of the market, customer, and business to make sound decisions

  • Team Player – The Product Owner is committed to the team and works with the team collaboratively to deliver value to our customers.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a comparable discipline; an MBA is a plus

  • 4+ years’ experience working as a Product Owner or similar role with a development team

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) is preferred

  • Experience with complex customer environments and/or relevant industry experience

  • Experience leading software product development in an Agile environment leveraging frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe

  • Strong team/project management, communication, and presentation skills

  • Self-motivated, energetic and can work both autonomously and as part of the team

  • Ability to be flexible and adaptable in a changing environment

Do you enjoy understanding what drives customer behaviour, spotting commercial opportunities and using data to influence better decisions? As a Commercial Insights Analyst at JT, you'll play a key role in helping the business understand performance across our Consumer and Small Business portfolios, turning complex information into clear, actionable insight that supports growth, retention and customer value.
Working as part of our Commercial team, you'll partner with colleagues across the business to explore trends, evaluate opportunities and provide evidence-based recommendations. From analysing customer behaviours and market dynamics to assessing the potential impact of new initiatives, you'll help bring commercial insight and perspective to decisions across the business.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong analytical capability with commercial curiosity and enjoys connecting the dots between data, customers and business outcomes. You'll gain exposure to a broad range of commercial activities, develop your ability to influence stakeholders and build a deeper understanding of how a leading telecommunications and digital services business creates value for its customers and communities.
JT is committed to building a diverse and inclusive working environment and JT Family. We will ensure that all individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in job applications, interviews, onboarding processes and beyond. Should you require any support or assistance in making your application, please contact us at .

Key Responsibilities

  1. Develop and maintain annual budgets, forecasts and commercial plans for the Consumer and Small Business portfolio, ensuring alignment with business objectives and financial targets.
  2. Monitor and analyse customer, revenue, margin, ARPU, acquisition and churn performance, identifying trends, opportunities and risks and recommending actions to improve commercial outcomes.
  3. Develop customer, revenue and margin forecasts, identifying variances to plan and recommending corrective actions where required.
  4. Conduct scenario analysis and commercial modelling to assess the impact of pricing changes, product developments, market trends and strategic initiatives.
  5. Create and maintain customer segmentation models and performance dashboards to identify opportunities for acquisition, retention, upsell and revenue growth.
  6. Analyse customer behaviour, usage patterns and purchasing trends to generate actionable insights supporting product, marketing and digital initiatives.
  7. Monitor competitor activity, market developments and industry trends, translating insights into recommendations that strengthen commercial performance and customer value propositions.
  8. Partner with stakeholders across the business to evaluate performance, identify opportunities and support delivery of commercial objectives.
  9. Provide constructive commercial challenge, ensuring business proposals, initiatives and investment decisions are supported by robust analysis and sound commercial rationale.
  10. Support the development of business cases, commercial assessments and recommendations for new products, propositions and strategic initiatives.
  11. Produce executive-level reporting, presentations and insights to support decision-making within Commercial Leadership, Product Governance and other strategic forums.
  12. Build trusted stakeholder relationships across Commercial, Finance and Operational teams, acting as a valued business partner and advisor.
  13. Identify emerging commercial risks and opportunities, proactively highlighting areas requiring management intervention.
  14. Drive improvements in reporting, analytical methodologies and performance measurement frameworks to support effective decision-making.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Experience in a commercial insight, commercial analytics, business analysis, business intelligence or performance management role.
  • Experience in commercial planning, forecasting, business case development and performance management.
  • Experience analysing customer behaviour, acquisition, retention, product performance and commercial outcomes to support business decision-making.
  • Strong analytical and commercial modelling skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, assess risks and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience using reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience interpreting, analysing and presenting data from multiple sources to create meaningful management information and commercial insights.
  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations and actions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge assumptions and engage senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex analytical or technical concepts for a variety of audiences.

You are equally comfortable writing the service that exposes those SLIs through an API and reasoning about error budgets, alerting quality, and signal-to-noise. You should be self-directed, able to own reliability definitions end to end, and effectively communicate them across teams.

  • Define SLIs and SLOs based on the signals available across the platform — Kubernetes, bare-metal hosts, and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

  • Establish alerting and error-budget practices that maximize signal and minimize noise.

  • Partner with infrastructure, storage, and networking teams to ensure the right signals are instrumented and collected.

  • Diagnose reliability and performance issues across the observability stack and drive their resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in SRE, platform reliability, or a closely related software/infrastructure role.

  • Strong software engineering skills (e.g., Go or Python) with experience building and operating APIs or services in production.

  • Demonstrated experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for real production systems.

  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling — metrics, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and the signals it and its workloads emit.

  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, KOF) and Cluster API.

  • Familiarity with VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs at scale.

  • Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

What does Mirantis offer you?

By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. jobs.description:
Job Description: Chief Anti-Money Laundering Officer (Chief AML Officer / CAMLO)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) / Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Board Compliance Committee

Job Summary

The Chief AML Officer (CAMLO) is responsible for leading the organization's Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), and financial crime prevention programs. This role ensures compliance with all applicable AML/CFT regulations and protects the organization from financial crime risks, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions violations.

The CAMLO serves as the primary authority on AML matters, overseeing policies, systems, investigations, and regulatory engagement to maintain a strong compliance and risk management framework.

Key Responsibilities

1. AML/CFT Strategy & Program Management

Develop and implement enterprise-wide AML/CFT strategies and frameworks

Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and international standards (e.g., FATF guidelines)

Continuously enhance AML programs to address emerging risks

Promote a strong financial crime compliance culture

2. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with AML/CFT laws, regulations, and regulatory expectations

Oversee timely and accurate regulatory reporting (e.g., suspicious transaction reports – STRs)

Act as the primary liaison with regulators and financial intelligence units (FIUs)

Manage regulatory inspections, audits, and reviews

3. Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC)

Oversee KYC, CDD, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) processes

Ensure proper onboarding and monitoring of customers

Implement risk-based customer profiling and segmentation

Monitor high-risk customers and politically exposed persons (PEPs)

4. Transaction Monitoring & Investigations

Oversee transaction monitoring systems and suspicious activity detection

Lead investigations into suspicious transactions and financial crime risks

Ensure timely escalation and reporting of suspicious activities

Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory bodies when required

5. Sanctions & Financial Crime Risk Management

Manage sanctions screening and compliance programs

Ensure adherence to international sanctions regimes

Identify and mitigate financial crime risks across the organization

Implement controls to prevent fraud, bribery, and corruption

6. Policies, Controls & Governance

Develop and maintain AML policies, procedures, and internal controls

Ensure audit readiness and documentation standards

Conduct regular AML risk assessments

Align AML programs with enterprise risk and compliance frameworks

7. Training & Awareness

Develop AML training programs for employees

Promote awareness of AML/CFT obligations and risks

Ensure staff understand policies and reporting requirements

Foster a culture of vigilance and compliance

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop AML and financial crime compliance teams

Establish performance standards and accountability

Drive continuous improvement and innovation in AML practices

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in AML, compliance, financial crime, or risk roles

Proven experience in senior AML leadership roles (e.g., Chief AML Officer, Head of AML, Financial Crime Leader)

Strong background in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and frameworks (e.g., FATF, local regulations)

Expertise in KYC, transaction monitoring, and investigations

Strong analytical and risk assessment skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High ethical standards and attention to detail

Ability to manage complex regulatory environments

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Compliance with AML/CFT regulations

Timeliness and accuracy of STR/SAR filings

Effectiveness of transaction monitoring systems

Reduction in financial crime risks and incidents

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Employee AML training completion and awareness

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Strong relationships with regulators and FIUs

Exposure to regtech and AML technology solutions

Ability to manage complex financial crime risks

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances
