Job Description Summary


This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

Job description summary

The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novar-tis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Rare Disease will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening rare disease-focused data partnerships that support the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across rare dis-ease brands, customer engagement, patient access, patient finding, and field execution.

This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic rare disease data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and rare disease data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant rare disease data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement the organization’s rare disease data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial rare disease brands, functions, and priority use cases.
  • Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic rare disease data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external rare disease data assets.
  • Apply deep understanding of rare disease data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, patient identification challenges, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.
  • Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external rare disease data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.
  • Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, patient services, and cross-functional rare disease teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
  • Implement oversight mechanisms for external rare disease data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.
  • Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that rare disease data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.
  • Track rare disease data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand rare disease business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.
  • Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.

Experience:

Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing rare disease data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of healthcare and rare disease data, including the strengths, limitations, governance considerations, and business applications of external data assets. Prior experience working with or for a data vendor is strongly preferred, as this role requires the ability to assess vendor capabilities, challenge data assumptions, manage partnership performance, and translate rare disease business needs into practical data solutions. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, compliance, and small patient population considerations, while building mutually beneficial vendor partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s rare disease data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights, vendor expertise, and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on rare disease, healthcare data, data governance, data management, or related roles.
  • Prior experience working with or for a data vendor, data provider, healthcare data platform, or analytics organization is strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of rare disease data assets, including data sourcing, patient identification, data coverage, refresh cadence, linkage, quality considerations, and fit-for-purpose business use cases.
  • Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to healthcare data privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of rare disease data.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and change management skills in a complex organizational environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess vendor data quality, identify data gaps, manage risks associated with external data partnerships, and ensure the integrity, security, and quality of shared data.
  • Experience working with IQVIA, Komodo, MMIT, Symphony, Definitive Healthcare, Veeva, claims/EHR data providers, patient services data, specialty pharmacy data, or similar healthcare and rare disease data sources is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate rare disease business needs into data solutions and guide teams in selecting and leveraging the right data sets to support decision-making.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $145,600.00 and $270,400.00 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

jobs.excerpt: The Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Sales Engineer serves as a specialized overlay technical resource responsible for helping enterprise customers modernize their cryptographic infrastructure and prepare for the transition to quantum-safe security.
jobs.description:
The Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Sales Engineer serves as a specialized overlay technical resource responsible for helping enterprise customers modernize their cryptographic infrastructure and prepare for the transition to quantum-safe security. This individual partners with regional Sales Engineers and Account Executives to articulate the technical value of Sectigo's solutions through customer discovery, solution architecture, technical presentations, cryptographic assessments, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and hands-on implementation activities.

This senior level professional possesses exceptional technical, presentation, consulting, and communication skills, enabling strategic customers to assess their current cryptographic environments, understand modernization opportunities, and develop practical adoption strategies that align with their security, compliance, and business objectives.

This is a full-time, remote role, and we’re ideally looking for someone based in the greater London area. The target compensation range is between GBP 120K to 160K, with an 80/20 split between base salary and commission, depending on your experience and background. We also review compensation based on market trends, business needs, and the scope of the territory, so there may be flexibility for the right candidate.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to CISOs, enterprise architects, PKI administrators, security teams, and executive stakeholders, guiding customers through cryptographic modernization and quantum readiness initiatives.
  • Partner with regional Sales Engineers and Account Executives to identify, develop, and support strategic opportunities involving cryptographic modernization, Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), Private PKI, and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).
  • Lead technical discovery engagements to assess customer cryptographic environments, certificate inventories, trust relationships, enterprise PKI architectures, and machine identities.
  • Conduct cryptographic and quantum readiness assessments, helping customers identify risks, prioritize modernization efforts, and develop practical migration strategies.
  • Deliver executive presentations, technical workshops, demonstrations, and architectural reviews that communicate both the immediate and long-term value of Sectigo's security solutions.
  • Provide deep technical guidance during architecture reviews and solution design, ensuring deployments align with customer requirements, security best practices, and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Lead Proof of Concept (PoC) engagements by planning, deploying, configuring, implementing, and validating Sectigo solutions within customer environments.
  • Perform hands-on implementation activities including deployment of discovery technologies, technical integrations, connector configuration, and validation as required during customer engagements.
  • Bridge the gap between technology and business objectives by helping customers understand the value of cryptographic modernization, Certificate Lifecycle Management, and machine identity security.
  • Assist with sales proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Requests for Information (RFIs), ensuring technical accuracy and competitive differentiation.
  • Develop and refine repeatable methodologies, assessment frameworks, technical playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices supporting Sectigo's cryptographic modernization practice.
  • Contribute to the SE Readiness Program by developing subject matter expertise, sharing technical best practices, maintaining current knowledge of assigned solutions, and delivering technical enablement to the field organization.
  • Work closely with Product Management and Engineering, providing field-driven feedback to influence future product capabilities, customer experience, and solution strategy.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Strategic Alliances to support solution adoption, partner enablement, and customer success.
  • Represent Sectigo as a technical thought leader by participating in customer workshops, executive briefings, conferences, webinars, industry events, and technical content development.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment under minimal supervision.
  • Willing to travel regionally and internationally for customer-facing activities, strategic partner engagements, conferences, and internal planning sessions.
  • Participate in strategic alliance initiatives, strengthening relationships with technology partners and strategic customers.
  • Additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned.
  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience is strongly recommended.
  • Microsoft Certified Professional (considered an asset).
  • Linux/Solaris/UNIX System Administration (considered an asset).
  • Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud certification (considered an asset).
  • Security, PKI, or cryptography-related certifications (considered an asset).

Experience:

  • Minimum of 7+ years of industry experience, with at least 3-4 years in an enterprise pre-sales environment.
  • Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Security Architect, or Professional Services Engineer supporting enterprise security, identity, or cloud solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Windows Server platforms, Linux environments, and enterprise authentication technologies.
  • Extensive experience with Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), including automated certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and lifecycle automation.
  • Expertise establishing and managing Private PKI environments, including Certificate Authorities (CAs), enterprise trust models, and PKI integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), SSL/TLS, X.509 certificates, digital identity, cryptographic principles, and machine identity management.
  • Strong understanding of cryptographic algorithms, key management, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), digital signatures, and enterprise trust architectures.
  • Working knowledge of cryptographic modernization, crypto-agility principles, and Post-Quantum Cryptography concepts is highly desirable.
  • Experience conducting enterprise technical discovery, architecture assessments, and solution design for complex customer environments.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, integrating, and validating enterprise security solutions.
  • Strong cloud experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud (preferred).
  • Proficiency with scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, Bash) and REST APIs (preferred).

Ability and availability to travel:   

  • Must be able to travel more than 35% of the time to the assigned regions and/or territories.

Talents and Desired Qualifications

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to guide customers through long-term cryptographic modernization and security transformation initiatives.
  • Strong consulting skills with the ability to translate complex cryptographic and security concepts into practical business value.
  • Exceptional customer discovery and architectural assessment skills.
  • Deep experience in enterprise solution architecture, technical design, and competitive positioning.
  • Strong hands-on technical capabilities with the ability to deploy, configure, integrate, and validate enterprise security solutions.
  • Ability to influence customer technical strategy while collaborating effectively with regional Sales Engineers, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Strategic Alliances.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, enterprise architects, PKI administrators, and executive leadership.
  • Self-starter with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, capable of managing multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated customer service, account management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Experience selling Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technical solutions.
  • Strong multitasking, troubleshooting, and technical problem-resolution abilities.
  • English language proficiency required. (Other languages are considered an asset.)
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time if required.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Global team. Global reach. Global impact.

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.

Simplicity at Scale.

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

Our organization

The Alberta Securities Commission (ASC) is the industry-funded regulator responsible for administering the province's securities laws. It is entrusted with fostering a fair and efficient capital market in Alberta and with protecting investors. As a member of the Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA), the ASC works to improve, coordinate and harmonize the regulation of Canada's capital markets.

The Market Regulation (MR) division oversees equities and derivatives marketplaces, registrants (dealers, advisers, and investment fund managers), and industry self-regulatory organizations. With a dynamic team of investment and financial professionals, we are involved in leading-edge projects aimed at balancing effective regulation with our stakeholders’ need for innovation and efficient capital markets.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Legal, Market Regulation the successful candidate will assist with the development of securities regulatory policy, engage with market participants to understand the securities-related challenges they face, and consider securities regulatory solutions to those challenges. They will conduct legal research and analysis for market regulation issues including initiatives being developed and implemented in other jurisdictions.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for the successful candidate to apply their skills to the application of securities law requirements on initiatives involving rapidly evolving technologies while balancing innovation and investor protection.

The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of, and interest in, capital markets and the registration and oversight of its participants, in both traditional and emerging market categories. This role will require knowledge of technology driven innovations such as crypto-asset trading platforms, digital assets, and fintech.

Key responsibilities include

  • Conducting legal analysis and providing advice and recommendations with respect to matters involving registration, compliance matters, and policy development with a variety of entities including crypto-asset trading platforms, fintech firms, and marketplaces.
  • Participating on national working groups to ensure consistent application of securities laws across Canada, as well as identifying emerging issues and analyzing and developing related policy.
  • Working on committees that consider and address the regulation of crypto-asset trading platforms and digital asset-related developments.
  • Providing legal input and direction to the Registration and Registrant Oversight, Derivatives Oversight, and Market Oversight teams.
  • Drafting concise legal memos to Market Regulation leaders, summarizing relevant areas of law and new developments.
  • Presenting policy recommendations to Market Regulation leaders, ASC executives and Commission members.
  • Interacting directly with industry participants in one-on-one meetings, public education sessions and advisory committees.

The ideal candidate will possess

  • A law degree and membership in good standing (or eligible for membership) with the Law Society of Alberta.
  • 10 plus years of experience in one or more areas of securities, corporate/commercial, regulatory, or administrative law.
  • Strong written advocacy skills and the ability to succinctly explain complex legal and businessmatters.
  • Relevant experience in dealing with digital assets or fintech is highly preferred.
  • Industry experience in securities law including dealing with registrants, marketplaces and related securities law requirements.

  • The ability to meet tight deadlines, work well in a team environment, and manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
  • Excellent tact and diplomacy, and the ability to work productively with staff at all levels of the ASC and with other Canadian jurisdictions.

About the Role

Enterprise deals aren't won by a single email or a single seller. They're won by a coordinated push that reaches every stakeholder in the room, at the right moment, with the right message.

As our Account-Based Marketing Manager, you'll own the programs that turn our highest-value Enterprise and Strategic accounts into pipeline. You'll work directly with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Partnerships to build 1:1 and 1:few plays that engage buying groups and move complex, multi-stakeholder deals forward. This is a role for someone who's comfortable building from limited precedent and translating account strategy into campaigns that actually change how a deal moves.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute ABM programs for a defined portfolio of Enterprise and Strategic accounts, from strategy through campaign delivery.
  • Design 1:1 and 1:few ABM plays that engage decision-makers and full buying groups, not just single contacts.
  • Partner with Sales on account plans, opportunity progression, and executive engagement, acting as the marketing counterpart to their account strategy.
  • Build personalized messaging and content experiences tailored to enterprise stakeholders, translating account priorities into a value narrative.
  • Run multi-channel campaigns across LinkedIn, email, paid media, content hubs, direct mail, and events, sequencing channels to match where each account is in the funnel.
  • Lead high-touch executive engagement initiatives, including curated dinners, events, and account-specific experiences that build senior-level relationships.
  • Drive account research to surface buying group members, whitespace, and engagement signals that inform where to focus next.
  • Track account engagement, campaign performance, and pipeline impact across the portfolio, and use those signals to reallocate effort toward what's working.
  • Test new ABM tactics and engagement approaches, treating each program as a hypothesis to validate rather than a template to repeat.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 4-7 years of B2B marketing experience with strong exposure to enterprise demand generation, ABM, or strategic account marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience executing multi-channel ABM programs targeting complex buying groups.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate account engagement and pipeline signals and adjust programs accordingly.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales to support account strategies and opportunity progression.
  • Ability to independently plan and execute marketing initiatives aligned with broader strategic objectives.
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn, and ABM or intent tools.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and plans need to adapt in real time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience running executive-level engagement programs (dinners, curated events, VIP experiences).
  • Background in SaaS or fintech, where enterprise sales cycles involve multiple senior stakeholders.

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Treat a stalled enterprise deal as a puzzle to solve, not someone else's problem.
  • Can build a program from scratch when there's no playbook to follow.
  • Read pipeline and engagement data as a starting point for the next test, not a report to file away.
  • Move comfortably between big-picture account strategy and the details of a single campaign asset.
  • Build real working relationships with sellers instead of treating Sales as a stakeholder to manage.
  • Hold a high bar for personalization. Generic ABM doesn't move enterprise buying groups.
  • Take ownership of outcomes, not just activity. Pipeline impact is the scoreboard.

jobs.description:
Job Title: AI Architect
Location: Remote (anywhere from India)
Timings :11 am to 8pm

Job Summary
This is a foundational hire. AI is being built and shipped across every product line in the portfolio, often in isolation. Duplication of models, tools, and infrastructure is driving up cost and slowing us down. The AI Architect will lead the definition of our target-state AI architecture, stand up the central AI services platform that every product will consume, and drive the delivery roadmap that consolidates and scales AI across the portfolio.
The role is technical and strategic. You will make the architecture decisions, then own their execution. You will build a small central team over time, but in the first six months you will operate primarily as a hands-on architect and delivery lead. AI is Phase 1 of a broader central services strategy at PairSoft; the pattern you set here will extend to other shared capabilities.

Responsibilities / Essential Functions
Architecture
  • Define and publish the target-state AI architecture across the product lines, including central services versus application-layer boundaries.
  • Own the technology decisions: foundation model providers, orchestration frameworks, vector stores, evaluation and observability platforms, guardrails, and agent frameworks.
  • Establish architecture decision criteria and the decision-record process. Ensure every significant call is defensible, documented, and revisitable.
  • Design for tenant isolation, PII handling, and regional data residency from day one, working with the CISO on the security envelope.
Delivery
  • Lead the build of the central AI platform: model gateway, prompt registry, RAG-as-a-service, guardrails and content safety, evals and telemetry, cost attribution, and audit logging.
  • Own the phased roadmap: discovery and decisions, platform build, migration of existing product AI features to the platform, and optimization.
  • Partner with product engineering leaders across all product lines to migrate existing AI features onto the central platform without disrupting customer commitments.
  • Set the operational bar: observability, SLOs, incident response, and on-call model for AI services.
Governance & Economics
  • Stand up per-request cost tagging and the AI unit economics dashboard. Track cost per feature, per customer, and per model. Enforce budgets and rate limits per tenant.
  • Chair a cross-product AI Council to govern shared standards, new use case intake, and vendor decisions.
  • Own vendor relationships for AI infrastructure and tooling. Lead build-versus-buy analysis and commercial negotiation with product and finance partners.
  • Prepare and represent the AI architecture and roadmap in leadership reviews and private-equity sponsor conversations, including technical due diligence.
Team
  • Recruit and lead the AI Platform team as the function grows.
  • Establish the operating model between the central platform team and embedded AI engineers across product lines.
  • Mentor engineers across the portfolio on AI patterns, evaluation practices, and safe deployment.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior architecture roles at enterprise B2B SaaS companies.
  • 3+ years of hands-on production experience with LLM-based systems: RAG, agents, evaluation, prompt engineering, and inference optimization.
  • 3+ years people management experience, including recruitment, motivation and development of 3+ teams in global setting.
  • Demonstrated track record building an AI or ML platform consumed by multiple product teams. You have designed and shipped shared infrastructure, not just individual features.
  • Strong delivery leadership. You have shipped platforms on time, on budget, and with the operational discipline required to run them in production.
  • Deep cloud-native architecture experience on Azure and AWS. Comfort with Kubernetes, IaC, and modern data platforms.
  • Fluency across the modern LLM ecosystem: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, open-source models, LangChain or LlamaIndex, vector databases, and observability tools like LangSmith or Langfuse.
  • Clear grasp of AI security and compliance: prompt injection, tenant isolation, PII handling, SOC 2, GDPR, and the vendor risk questions PE-owned SaaS companies face.
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions and tradeoffs to executive audiences, including private equity sponsors and technical due diligence teams.
  • Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications
  • Domain experience in procure-to-pay, ERP integration, accounts payable, procurement, or adjacent finance and operations software.
  • Prior experience at an international PE-backed B2B SaaS company, ideally one that went through or is preparing for a liquidity event.
  • Experience integrating and consolidating AI capabilities across products acquired through mergers and acquisitions.
  • Direct experience with agent frameworks in production (LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestration), fine-tuning, and multi-model routing.
  • Experience leading a central platform team through a technology consolidation program.
  • Prior participation in technical due diligence, either as owner or advisor.

Work and Physical Requirements
This position may work from home and/or office environment. Working in an office environment may require prolonged sitting, work in an air-conditioned environment, ability to work with others at various noise levels and ability to lift up to 30 pounds or 15 kg.

Other Duties
This job description is not intended to be a complete list of responsibilities. Other duties may be assigned by management that may reasonably fit in the scope of job.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

About the Company

We are a global team of innovators and advocates transforming how financial data is captured, stored, and manipulated with our comprehensive suite of automation technology. Our platform seamlessly integrates with your existing ERP for an unrivaled end-user experience. We do the heavy lifting so accounting, procurement, and fundraising teams can do their best work.

PairSoft’s aspires to be the strongest procure-to-pay platform for the mid-market and enterprise, with close integration to Microsoft Dynamics, Blackbaud, Oracle, SAP, Acumatica and Sage ERPs.

Accounts Receivable Analyst Job Description

ABOUT THIS ROLE: Chicago IL/Remote


The AR Analyst is the central figure of responsibility in the successful management of Account Receivables balances. The primary responsibility of the AR Analyst is to establish and maintain communication lines with various customer departments that may impact the payment status of customers, thus impacting Accounts Receivable. The ideal AR Analyst will proactively identify and quantify credit risk issues and create solutions for the resolution of these items. The position requires excellent communication and negotiating skills, strong analytical skills, and advanced organizational and presentation abilities.


Additional duties include but are not limited to:


  • Review and analyze 1250+ Dealer Customer AR accounts by making collection inquiries and efforts via phone and email
  • Ability to proactively research any billing discrepancies causing the collection issue and make necessary corrections, including but not limited to: processing cancellation requests, issuing credits, applying misapplied payments and writing off debt when necessary.
  • Communicate to customer in a professional manner
  • Work closely with Sales to escalate and communicate the collection issues and communicate the resolution to Sales
  • Thoroughly document all contacts on each account
  • Responsible for meeting weekly, monthly and quarterly collection goals on assigned accounts.
  • Prepare credits and/or billing corrections per established company guidelines

  • ACCOUNTABILITY AND DECISION MAKING:
  • Responsible for managing all aspects of the Accounts Receivable accounts assigned in accordance with the Company credit and collection guidelines and policies.
  • Responsible for communicating to the respective departments the root cause for collection issues that are related to billing discrepancies, product performance issues, sales issue, etc.
  • Ability to provide resolution to collection issues to Management
  • Ability to quickly identify accounts at risk proactively before delinquency become inevitable

INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL CONTACTS:


  • Communicate with external customers in a professional manner at all times to determine the root cause for the collection issue.
  • Communicate with Sales to inform issues with their accounts and provide resolution
  • Communicate collection issues due to internal process/training or product issues resulting in collections issues so the issues are addressed in a timely manner

Required Skills:


  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • General knowledge of accounts receivable
  • Knowledge of internet and email protocols
  • Ability to learn various systems used to document collection efforts (Salesforce, Psoft)
  • Ability to meet monthly AR goals as provided by Management
  • Ability to analyze AR account trends and proactively resolve any collection issues
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel and Word) program
  • Knowledge of G-Suite (Gmail, Sheets & Docs) program
  • Knowledge of Peoplesoft preferred

Required Experience:


  • 4 Year College Degree
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced changing environment.
  • 2 to 4 years of work experience required, in related area preferred

jobs.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview :

We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Tamil-speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.

You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services.
  • Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.
  • Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.
  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.
  • Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Hindi and a good command of English.
  • Previous experience in telesales or sales roles is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.
  • Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.
  • Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

Lyntrisis a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace.Lyntrisbrings together the talents ofAccelintand Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deepexpertisewithin their domain.Combining differentiated hardware,softwareand missionexpertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed,precisionand confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, SpaceForceand allied partners — spanning strategic,operationaland tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs,Lyntrisworks at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over.Lyntrismoves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

  • Senior Product Designer
  • Full time
  • Remote

The Senior Product Designer is responsible for leading the design of intuitive, scalable, and technically grounded digital product experiences from early problem definition through implementation. This role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and other stakeholders to translate complex business and technical requirements into thoughtful product experiences, interaction models, and high-fidelity prototypes.

The Senior Product Designer operates with a high degree of autonomy and contributes beyond traditional interface design by helping shape product strategy, explore solutions, and reduce ambiguity through rapid, AI-enabled prototyping. The role also serves as a bridge between design and engineering, using interactive prototypes to validate product behaviors, communicate design intent, and support efficient implementation.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and key stakeholders to define problem spaces, understand user needs, establish success criteria, and translate ambiguous business and technical requirements into clear product concepts and experience strategies.
  • Lead end-to-end product design across user journeys, interaction models, system states, and high-fidelity interfaces, creating intuitive, scalable experiences that align with product and business objectives while accounting for real-world usage and edge cases.
  • Facilitate design thinking engagements, including workshops, ideation sessions, discovery exercises, and design sprints, to explore opportunities, generate solutions, and build alignment across stakeholders.
  • Develop high-fidelity, interactive prototypes using Figma and AI-assisted or no-code tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or similar platforms to rapidly explore and validate product concepts.
  • Create prototypes that demonstrate realistic user flows, conditional logic, system behaviors, edge cases, and representative data, using interactive prototypes as tangible tools for decision-making, validation, and engineering implementation.
  • Leverage AI-assisted design and prototyping workflows, including Figma MCP or comparable integrations, to improve design-system alignment, accelerate exploration, and model lightweight logic, workflows, and functional behaviors.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to ensure designs and prototypes are technically grounded, implementation-ready, and clearly communicate system logic, states, behaviors, and design intent.
  • Contribute beyond interface design by influencing product strategy, roadmap decisions, opportunity framing, and solution direction across complex and ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Present design solutions, prototypes, trade-offs, constraints, and rationale to clients, stakeholders, engineers, and executive leadership, adapting communication to the needs of each audience and driving alignment through demonstrated product behaviors.
  • Apply user research, testing, task success measures, usability feedback, and other relevant insights to refine product experiences and improve usability outcomes.
  • Operate autonomously with a high degree of ownership while managing complex design challenges, identifying opportunities, resolving ambiguity, and driving work toward measurable outcomes.
  • Mentor and support mid-level and junior designers in product design, interaction modeling, prototyping methods, and AI-assisted design workflows.
  • Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems and modern product design practices that improve consistency, speed, clarity, and technical alignment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Senior-level experience in product design, UX/UI design, interaction design, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience designing end-to-end digital product experiences, including user flows, interaction models, system states, and high-fidelity interfaces.
  • Experience translating ambiguous business or technical requirements into clear product and experience solutions.
  • Strong experience with prototyping and interactive design tools, including Figma or comparable platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to create prototypes that represent realistic user flows, system behaviors, conditional logic, and edge cases.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale, trade-offs, constraints, and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in complex and ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Experience working with design systems and contributing to their continued evolution.
  • Ability to incorporate AI-assisted design and prototyping tools into product design workflows.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering to create technically grounded, implementation-ready product solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and provide guidance to less-experienced designers.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. national security clearance. To learn more about the security clearance process, please access this link.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Experience working in defense, national security, government, or other highly technical environments.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or prototyping tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using Figma MCP or comparable integrations to support design-system alignment and technical workflows.
  • Experience integrating real or representative datasets into interactive prototypes.
  • Experience participating in or leading design thinking workshops, discovery exercises, or design sprints.
  • Experience influencing product strategy, roadmap decisions, and opportunity framing.
  • Experience working directly with clients or external stakeholders in strategic product design engagements.
  • Active-duty military experience.
  • Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able tolift upto 15 pounds at times. 
  • This position requires the ability to travel up to 10%.

Clearance Requirements

Some positions willrequire access to U.S. National Security information. Positionsthat require this access will berequiredto receive andmaintaina U.S. government personnel security clearance (PCL). In order toqualify for this position, the candidate must be a US Citizen and either currentlypossessthis National Security eligibility or be able to complete the investigation application process with a favorable determination andmaintainthat eligibility throughout their employment. The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

Dexcom’s Global Medical Affairs is a rapidly expanding team, and we are seeking an experienced Medical Affairs professional to join our team and be part of Dexcom’s award-winning culture, recognized by Fortune's Best Workplaces in Health Care & Biopharma.

The Sr. Medical Affairs Manager will be a key contributor to Dexcom’s global scientific conference strategy, driving high‑impact medical and scientific engagement across priority international meetings. This role is responsible for end‑to‑end conference planning and execution, including cross‑functional collaboration with Clinical Affairs, HEOR, Behavioral Science, Data Science, Scientific Communications/Medical Writing, Clinical Education, Marketing, Market Access, and Integrated Evidence Planning.

This role will critically evaluate clinical, real‑world, and outcomes data to guide abstract development and scientific submissions, ensuring alignment with business priorities, evidence‑generation needs, and good publication practice.

The Sr. Medical Affairs Manager is an individual contributor role, with no direct reports, and will require a strong, independent, strategic thinker with global vision and understanding. The ideal candidate brings deep Medical Affairs expertise, strong medical communications and global scientific conference planning experience, and a solid understanding of the diabetes, diabetes technology and adjacent health conditions to help advance Dexcom’s global scientific leadership.

Where you come in:

  • You will be a key contributor to the end‑to‑end global scientific conference strategy to expand Dexcom’s scientific presence across priority international meetings.
  • You will facilitate strategic cross‑functional planning with Clinical Affairs, HEOR, Behavioral Science, Data Science, Scientific Communications/Medical Writing, Clinical Education, Marketing, Market Access and Integrated Evidence Planning, as well as regional leaders as appropriate.
  • You will be responsible for tactical execution of the scientific conference strategy, including timelines, deliverables, and cross‑functional alignment from concept through presentation.
  • You will lead and facilitate cross‑functional conference planning and data review meetings.
  • You will critically evaluate clinical, real‑world, and outcomes data to inform scientific conference submissions aligned with global business priorities and evidence needs, with a focus in emerging markets and new geographies such as APAC and LATAM.
  • Proactively plan for new product and feature post-market evidence needs to support product claims, both globally and regionally.
  • Provide strategic planning and direction for medical and scientific communications at regional and in-country conferences with upcoming studies, new publications, etc.
  • Measure impact of scientific conference initiatives.

What makes you successful:

  • Strong expertise in medical communications planning, including abstract development and the scientific abstract submission process.
  • Deep understanding of Medical Affairs roles, industry regulations, publication standards, and best practices globally and in-country nuances.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of diabetes and diabetes technologies, including CGM.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders to ensure full alignment of roles and responsibilities, strategy, tactics, expectations, and timelines
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate complex evidence into clear, compelling scientific narratives for external scientific audiences.
  • Solid project management and organizational skills with the capacity to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to assess current processes, identify barriers, and provide new, more efficient or effective direction for such processes to support business timelines and priorities.
  • Ability to provides insight to the development of Medical Affairs functional objectives in the sub-function of Medical and Scientific Communications to support the achievement of corporate goals.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. Learn more about our #dexcomwarriors community. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

Travel Required:

  • 15-25%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree with 13+ years of industry experience
  • 5-8 years of previous people management experience.
  • Advanced degree preferred (Master’s, MPH, PhD, or PharmD) in a science‑related field.
  • Prior industry experience in scientific conference planning, and industry or agency medical communications planning or publication management.

Remote Workplace:

Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

What sets you up for success

  • Strong skills in PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, and schema design

How You Operate

  • Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability -- we use Postgres until it breaks

  • Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three" - Jeff Bezos. We wrote this job post during the weekend

  • Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

Benefits & Perks

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform - not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per hour equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

jobs.description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

 

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. 
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

What You'll Do

The Director, Publications and Scientific Communications will support the development and tactical execution of the publication strategy for acoramidis. This role includes serving as a publication lead, providing hands-on support throughout the publication planning and development cycle to ensure the quality of deliverables and compliant alignment with publication initiatives, organizational goals, and medical strategic imperatives. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in publication planning, scientific communications and publication development, and medical affairs, along with familiarity with real-world evidence (RWE) publications.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and execution of the publication strategy for studies (primarily RWE but may include clinical and preclinical), helping ensure alignment with medical strategic objectives and compliance with industry best practices (e.g., GPP, ICMJE, PRISMA, CONSORT, etc.).
  • Manage the development, review, and submission of manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and presentations across real-world evidence studies, and health economics outcomes research (HEOR) preclinical and clinical trials.
  • Collaborate with internal and external authors, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and research partners to develop high-impact scientific publications.
  • Support timely and high-quality execution of publication plans, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies.
  • Support the development of medical communication materials for the medical affairs team and cross-functional partners, including timely provision of information and resources needed for internal training.
  • Support identification of opportunities for integrating RWE into the broader scientific communication strategy.

Where You'll Work

This is a U.S.-based remote role that will require quarterly, or as needed visits to our San Francisco Office.

Who You Are

  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) in life sciences, medicine, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience in scientific publications, medical communications, or medical affairs within the pharmaceutical/biotech industry
  • Strong expertise in real-world evidence publications, including experience publishing observational studies, registry data, and HEOR findings
  • Proven track record of contributing to publication strategies and delivering high-impact peer-reviewed publications and congress materials
  • Deep understanding of scientific writing, data interpretation, and statistical concepts related to clinical and real-world research
  • Familiarity with publication management systems (e.g.: iEnvision) and strong knowledge of industry guidelines and best practices (GPP, ICMJE, etc.)
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Preferred: CMPP certification, Experience in cardiology and/or rare diseases , Prior medical writing experience
  • Some travel required (25%) to attend SF headquarters and conferences
At BridgeBio, we strive to provide a market-competitive total rewards package, including base pay, an annual performance bonus, company equity, and generous health benefits. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and length of experience within the job, type, and length of experience within the industry, educational background, location of residence and performance during the interview process. BridgeBio is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions based in other states.

$220,000—$260,000 USD

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location. We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

Financial & Rewards

Health & Well-Being

Emumba is looking for a high-energy, commercially driven SMB Sales Manager to help turn customer conversations into measurable business.
You’ll work with prospects generated through industry events, partnerships, referrals, and outbound efforts, including opportunities coming from events such as technology expos and conferences. The role is ideal for someone who understands cloud technology, communicates with confidence, stays highly organized, and knows how to move a sales conversation forward. You will be expected to attend industry events and travel in country.

Must Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in technology sales, cloud infrastructure, or related B2B technology environments
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft is essential. You will be expected to drive customer conversations.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, high energy, ownership, and a strong bias for action are necessary along with the abiltiy to unlearn and learn.
  • Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer conversations simultaneously. You will be expected to be on top of an active pipeline of 25-30 customer engagements at a time.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for moving opportunities through the sales process.
  • A master at creating sales pipeline with industry events and expos. You will be expected to sell Emumba’s value proposition along with AWS Cloud Infra with a net conversion resulting in scope of work.
  • AI-native approach to work, using Generative AI and modern sales tools to improve research, preparation, communication, and productivity. Speed is of the essence - deliverables that would normally take a week are expected to be delivered in an hour.
  • Ability to commit ~ 20 hours per week

What You’ll Do

Own Lead Conversion

  • Engage leads generated through events, partnerships, referrals, and other business-development channels.
  • Take ownership of leads from initial outreach through qualification and conversion.
  • Understand customer needs and identify where Emumba’s technology and cloud capabilities can create value.
  • Maintain momentum across opportunities through structured and timely follow-ups.
  • Translate promising conversations into qualified opportunities and measurable revenue.

Build Customer Relationships

  • Develop trusted relationships with prospective customers and key stakeholders.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand business challenges, technology environments, and buying priorities.
  • Clearly communicate Emumba’s capabilities across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, AI, and digital transformation.
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams where deeper solution expertise is required.

Manage the Sales Process

  • Maintain accurate records of prospects, conversations, next steps, and opportunities.
  • Prioritize leads based on commercial potential and likelihood of conversion.
  • Build disciplined follow-up rhythms to ensure opportunities continue progressing.
  • Provide clear visibility into pipeline activity, customer feedback, blockers, and expected outcomes.

Nice-to-Have

  • Existing relationships within the U.S. technology, cloud, or enterprise ecosystem
  • Experience selling AWS, Microsoft Azure, cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, managed services, or professional services
  • Experience working with AWS or Microsoft partner ecosystems
  • Experience following up on leads generated through conferences, expos, and industry events
  • Experience selling consulting or engineering services rather than only software products
  • Familiarity with Generative AI, AI transformation, or cloud-native technologies
  • Previous experience working with distributed or international technology teams

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, you will have built a structured follow-up motion for Emumba’s existing and incoming leads, established strong relationships with prospective customers, and created clear visibility into where the strongest commercial opportunities exist.
More importantly, success will be measured by conversion: turning conversations into qualified opportunities, opportunities into customer engagements, and customer engagements into revenue.

What’s In It for You

  • A flexible 20-hour-per-week role with meaningful ownership
  • The opportunity to work across cloud, AI, and emerging technology conversations
  • Opportunity to work with Emumba’s engineering, solution architecture, and leadership teams
  • Opportunity to drive customer conversations and sales pipeline in the U.S.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Health Economics & Actuarial Analytics
jobs.excerpt: About Foodsmart:Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.
jobs.description:
About Foodsmart:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the Role:

Foodsmart’s value proposition rests on a claim: we improve outcomes for the members who need it most, and we save payers real money doing it. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Health Economics & Actuarial Analytics who can make that claim airtight, rigorous enough to hold up when a payer’s own actuarial team pressure tests it.

This role owns the full chain from clinical improvement to economic value. It starts with measuring what actually changed for a client’s members: weight loss, A1c improvement, blood pressure control, HEDIS performance. It ends with quantifying what that improvement is worth and defending that number in front of the people writing the check.

You’ll also help shape our value-based care strategy, including which populations we should be targeting and what performance we can credibly commit to.

Health economists and actuaries approach these problems differently, and either can be excellent here. What matters is the standard you hold yourself to. Our numbers get validated by payers’ own actuarial teams, which means the work has to be built the way they would build it, with their assumptions about trend, credibility, and risk adjustment.

This is our most senior data science leadership role, reporting directly to the VP of Analytics & Data Science. You’ll lead a small team while staying deeply hands-on with the methodology yourself, and you’ll be expected to use AI as a genuine force multiplier, to move faster, go deeper, and extend your reach well beyond what the headcount alone would suggest. You’ll also be a partner on our peer-reviewed research work, which we pursue with academic collaborators and our founder and Chief Science Officer.

The strongest candidates will have done this inside a telehealth or digital health company, or will have built their foundation on the payer or consulting side and then moved into digital health. What matters most is that you have proven value to payers before, repeatedly, and know what it takes for those numbers to be believed.

You will:

  • Own how we measure clinical outcomes across client member populations: weight loss, A1c, blood pressure, food insecurity, HEDIS measures, and the quality metrics our clients hold us to.
  • Own Foodsmart’s ROI methodology: translating those clinical outcomes into economic value, and identifying which member populations we help the most.
  • Represent that methodology directly to payers and external actuarial and consulting firms, defending our approach under real technical scrutiny rather than just presenting a final number.
  • Own the analytical substance of the value story we tell individual clients, grounded in their own members’ outcomes rather than generic benchmarks.
  • Help shape our value-based care strategy, including which member populations to target and what performance we can credibly stand behind.
  • Build our outcomes and ROI methodology as a scalable system, one that extends to new populations and new client conversations without being rebuilt from scratch each time.
  • Partner on peer-reviewed research with academic collaborators
  • Work with our clinical team to translate findings and best practices into how care is actually delivered.
  • Lead and develop a small team while staying hands-on, and lean on AI and other tooling to extend how much ground you and your team can cover.

You are:

  • Rigorous in the way a payer’s actuarial team is rigorous. You reason about cost, utilization, risk, and credibility with real discipline, and you know where a methodology is most likely to be attacked.
  • Fluent in both clinical quality measurement and economic value, and comfortable moving between the two. You can look at a change in A1c across a population and know how to turn it into a number a payer will accept.
  • Comfortable being the technical counterpart to a payer’s own actuaries and consultants: unintimidated by scrutiny, and able to defend methodology choices in real time.
  • Seasoned. You have proven value to payers repeatedly, and you are not learning ROI methodology on the job.
  • A systems builder who thinks in terms of scale: a repeatable methodology, not a one-off analysis redone for every new client or payer.
  • Able to translate technical findings into how care actually gets delivered, working alongside clinical and care delivery teams.
  • Someone who treats AI as a genuine lever on your own impact. You actively look for ways to use it to work faster and go deeper, and you have a point of view on where it helps and where rigor still demands a human.
  • Comfortable leading a small team while staying personally hands-on with the hardest analytical work yourself.

You have:

  • A background in health economics, actuarial science, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of applying it to healthcare cost and value questions. An advanced degree or actuarial credentials (ASA, FSA, MAAA) are a plus but not required if you have equivalent hands-on depth.
  • Experience proving ROI and value inside a telehealth or digital health company, or a foundation on the payer or consulting side followed by time in digital health.
  • Hands-on experience measuring clinical outcomes and quality across populations, including familiarity with HEDIS and common chronic condition measures.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with healthcare claims data, both medical and pharmacy (Rx), including the practical realities of using it for cost and utilization analysis.
  • Deep expertise in causal inference as applied to healthcare cost and outcomes: matched cohort design, risk adjustment, and quasi-experimental methods.
  • Direct experience presenting and defending ROI methodology with payers, actuaries, or similarly technical external audiences.
  • Experience with value-based care arrangements and a point of view on what a provider or vendor can credibly commit to.
  • Peer-reviewed publication experience is a plus.
  • Experience partnering with clinical or care delivery teams to translate findings into practice.
  • Comfort working directly with data (SQL, R, or Python) to conduct your own analysis.
  • Familiarity with AI-native tooling (Claude Code, or equivalent) as a way to accelerate analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write for external, technical, and non-technical audiences alike.

About our benefits and perks:

✅ Remote-First Company

✅ Unlimited PTO

✅ Flexible & remote location

✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
✅ 401k & bonus

✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions

Foodsmart is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our firm policy to extend equal employment and advancement opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth and/or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability (physical or mental) and/or a medical condition, genetic information, ancestry, veteran status or service in the uniformed services, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
